Activity_ghost_enemy_rules:
According to our latest intel, the Allies' deserters have formed a Ghost Force, hiding in the shadows to plunder resources and military supplies. They are planning to ambush our troops at this time. All Guilds have been informed to defend against them.

Event Rules:
1. The event lasts for 2 days. After the event starts, Ghost Bases will appear on the map. Peace Shields can't stop Ghost Rebels from attacking your bases. Assemble your forces to defend against them;
2. R4 and R5 members of a Guild can start the event in the event interface. You can choose to start immediately or at a scheduled time. It's recommended that you start the event after fully discussing with your Guild members and choosing a time when most members are active.
3. After the event starts, the Ghost Bases will send out 25 waves of Ghost Rebels to attack Guild members. Waves 5/10/15/20/25 are Elite Rebels. Don't forget to reinforce your Guild members.
4. Each wave of Ghost Rebels will randomly attack a number of Guild members first, and then after a certain period, another a number of members, until all members have been attacked. Then the next wave will begin.
5. If a player has failed to defend against the Ghost Rebels two times in a row, they will stop attacking that player.
6. If 20% of Guild members have defended against 20 waves, the difficulty level of the event next time will increase by 1 star. If 20% of Guild members only defended against 5-20 waves, the difficulty level will remain the same. If 20% of Guild members failed to defend against even 5 waves, the difficulty level will reduce (lowest level is 1-Star). A higher difficulty means better rewards. Currently, the max difficulty level is 3-Star.

Rewards Info:
1. Successfully defending against a wave will earn you Wave Rewards;
2. Defense Rewards can be earned after reaching corresponding Individual Points and Guild Point requirements.
3. The top 100 players can get extra Leaderboard Rewards (Individual Points).
4. All members from the top 10 Guilds can also get extra Leaderboard Rewards (Guild Points).

Notes:
1. Ghost Rebels won't inflict any unit losses.
2. Reinforcing Guild members to defend against more waves of Ghost Rebels will also earn you Individual Points and Guild Points.(If the Garage is full, you will lose the injured troops)
3. If you quit a Guild after completing the event, your Individual Points and Guild Points will be cleared.
4. Ghost Rebels won't attack Guild members that haven't logged in for 3 days in a row.
5. If you teleport your base after the event starts, Ghost Rebels will stop attacking you right away, and the event ends for you.
6. Guild members under attack will show in [Attack Details] on the event interface.
7. When you are under attack, you can tap the button [Ask for Help], and your message will be sent to your Guild channel.

Activity_valentine_guild_info: A famous poet once said, “But by now, my desire and will were turned, like a balanced wheel rotated evenly by the love that moves the sun and other stars.” Love is a poem and the sun is in our life, and it can be found everywhere. Valentine's Day is just around the corner, and we've prepared tons of interesting events and amazing rewards for you. Tap the upper left corner to see more details.
Activity_valentine_guild_rule:
The Valentine event is divided into four parts, Sweet Affection, Cupid’s Call, Words of Roses, and Kiss of Cupid.

Sweet Affection:
Complete daily missions to obtain event items and amazing rewards.

Cupid’s Call:
Gather resources, defeat Invaders, and collect resources on your base to get special items needed for the events.

Kiss of Cupid:
Defeat Invaders in a row to obtain points, and claim amazing ranking rewards.

Words of Roses:
Cultivate your very own rose and win a Limited Officer Outfit!
Activity_valentine_task_rules:
1. This event will last for 8 days. In the first 5 days, 3 side events will be unlocked each day. You can obtain Roses by completing missions in the side events in the first 7 days.
2. On day 8, you won’t be able to complete missions, but extra chest rewards will be available for you to claim. Rewards are based on the number of missions you completed over the previous days.
3. Roses can be used in the Words of Roses event.
Activity_valentine_rose_rules:

4. When your Rose Arrangement reaches Lv25, You can exchange excess Roses for Medium Resource Chests at a 1:1 ratio.
5. Rewards at each stage can be claimed only once. This event won't be reset during this period.

Activity_easter_guild_info: The warm spring breeze brings everything back to the earth. The green grass buds and blooming lilies symbolize activity and vitality, and Easter is fast approaching. We've prepared limited edition outfits and plenty of rewards to celebrate this festival, and exciting Easter events are coming! Tap on the icon in the upper right corner to view.
Activity_easter_guild_rule:
The series of Easter events is divided into five parts: the Rebirth of All Things, the Day of Revival, Ode to Spring, Easter Eggs, and the Gift of Rebirth. 
 
 Rebirth of All Things (April 10-April 17):
 Receive holiday items and generous rewards by completing daily missions. 
 
 Day of Revival (April 10-April 16):
 Collect resources, defeat the invading enemy, collect resources in the base, and gather the items required for the Easter Egg events Resurrection - Easter Egg Paint. 
 
 Ode to Spring (April 11-April 12):
 Successively defeat the invading enemy and you will earn points to receive generous ranking rewards. 
 
 Easter Eggs (April 10-April 16):
 Make Easter eggs with your allies and receive rewards of great value! 
 
 Gift of Rebirth (April 10-April 17):
 Use the collected holiday items to redeem gifts. Don't miss the rare uniform for Riven!
Activity_easter_task_rules:
1. This event will last 8 days, during the first 5 days of which the system will unlock 3 sideline activities every day, and during the first 7 days a commander can obtain the "Easter Egg Paint" and "Golden Easter Egg" items by completing the tasks in the sideline interaction. 
 2. On the 8th day of the event, commanders will no longer be able to continue the tasks, but will be able to claim additional treasure chest rewards, which will be calculated based on the number of tasks completed successfully. 
 3. The "Easter Egg Paint" can be used in the Easter Egg Resurrection Events, and the "Golden Easter Eggs" can be used in the Gift of Rebirth events.
Activity_easter_egg_rules:
1. Easter eggs can be upgraded if you add Easter egg paint or spend gold coins on coloring. When the Easter eggs reach the designated level, all members of the Guild will receive corresponding rewards, which will be sent via email. 
 2. Each time you add Easter egg paint to an egg, you will get an egg fragment. This is valid even after the egg reaches the top level. 
 3. Each time you use your gold coin to color your Easter egg, you will get a golden Easter egg. This is valid even after the egg reaches the top level. 
 4. The golden Easter eggs and Easter egg fragments can be used to redeem various rewards, including Riven's limited uniforms, during the "Gift of Rebirth" events. 
 5. Each time you add paint to or use your gold coin to color an egg, there is a probability of a 'critical' effect, adding more experience value to the Easter egg. 
 6. The contribution list will show the contribution values of all commanders in the Guild in this event. Each time paint is added or a gold coin is used, a commander will earn 1 point in contribution value.

 3. Each time you use your gold coin to decorate a vase, you will get a letter. This effect continues even after the vase reaches maximum level.
 4. During the gifts phase flowers and letters can be used to redeem various rewards, including the limited edition base decoration.
 5. Each time you use a water drop or gold coins for the vases, there is a chance for a 'critical' effect, adding more experience points to the vase.
 6. The contribution list will show the contribution values of all commanders in the Guild in this event. Each time a water drop or a gold coin is used, a commander will earn 1 point in contribution value.
Activity_motherday_drop_rules:
1. During the event commanders will have a certain chance to find water drop items while collecting resources in and outside the city or after defeating an army of the invaders. Water drop items will be received by email.
 2. Water drops can be used to raise the level of flower vases in the "Flowers of Appreciation" event.

To celebrate, we've prepared an autumn-themed base decoration as well as plentiful rewards, so hurry to participate!
Activity_autumn_guild_rule:

Golden Autumn:
Complete daily missions to get items and generous rewards.

Blessing Preparation:
Gather resources, defeat Invaders, and collect resources in your base to get special items needed for the Autumn Blessing event: Blessing Ribbons.

Wild Commander:
Consecutively defeat Invaders to earn points and claim plentiful rankings rewards.

Autumn Blessing:

Harvest Celebration:

3. Every time you use Gold, you will get a Fortune Pouch, which will remain valid even after your Maple Tree reaches its maximum level.

5. Every time you use a Fortune Pouch or Gold, there's a chance to "crit", which adds even more EXP to the Maple Tree.
6. The Contribution List will show the contributions of every Commander in the Guild, and each time a Commander uses a Fortune Pouch or Gold, it will count as 1 Contribution Point.

Dear Commander, in order to transfer into this Zone you must meet the following conditions:
 
 1. The level of your headquarters must be greater than 16
 2. You must have sufficient transfer order books
 3. All of your troops must be listed in idle status
 4. Your city and troops must not be in a state of combat
 5. You may not belong to any guild

 8. Your power cannot exceed the <color=#ffb726> power limit </color> of the target zone.
 
 After a successful transfer, the game will automatically restart and your city will appear at a random location within the target zone after re-entering the game.

Activity_summer_guild_rule:
仲夏系列活动分为四个部分，热情仲夏、夏日派对、星夜之梦、仲夏之夜。

热情仲夏(6月15日-6月22日)：
通过完成每日任务获得节日道具和丰厚奖励。

夏日派对(6月15日-6月21日)：
收集资源、击败侵略军、基地内收取资源，获得仲夏秘盒，打开可获得仲夏之夜活动所需道具--树枝。

星夜之梦(6月16日-6月17日)：
连续击败侵略军获得积分，领取丰厚的排行奖励。

仲夏之夜(6月15日-6月21日)：
给篝火增添树枝达到对应等级，领取丰厚的个人奖励！

2.在活动的第8天，指挥官将无法再继续进行任务，但能够领取额外的宝箱奖励，奖励内容将根据成功完成的任务数量来计算。
3. “树枝”可在仲夏之夜活动中使用。

Activity_Alliance_Fest_detailed_rules:
The Guild Mobilization event only starts after your Guild reaches 15 members. Your HQ must be Lv.10 or higher in order to participate in the event.
Members can only claim missions after the event starts.
If you abandon a mission you've already claimed, your mission chances will not be returned.
Only the Guild Leader and R4 Officials can delete missions. New missions will be refreshed 30 minutes after deleting.
There are 5 difficulty levels in the event. From easiest to most difficult, they are: Private, Sergeant, Lieutenant, Colonel, and General.
The first time a Guild participates in the event, the "Private" difficulty is selected by default.
Guilds that rank in the top 3 in the Private, Sergeant, and Lieutenant difficulties, and whose Guild Points are at Lv.8 or above, will advance to the next difficulty the next time they participate in the event. The top 2 Guilds in the Colonel difficulty will be promoted to the highest difficulty.
Guilds that rank in the bottom 3, or whose Guild Points Level is too low, will go to a lower difficulty the next time they participate in the event.

- Gold claimed from purchasing Military Supplies

 - Free Gold gifted from First Purchases at the Gold Store</color>

Activity_pirate_guild_rule:
Viking Korsan etkinlikleri 4 bölüme ayrılır. Etkinlik sırasında daha fazla etkinlik eşyası almak için sınırlı süreli paketleri satın alabilirsin.

Korsan Mücadelesi:
Özel eşyalar ve mükemmel ödüller almak için günlük görevleri tamamla.

Korsan Definesi Avı:
Etkinlikler için gerekli özel eşyaları almak amacıyla kaynakları topla, İstilacıları alt et ve üssünde kaynak topla.

Hazır, Nişan Al, Ateş!
Puan kazanmak ve mükemmel sıralama ödülleri almak için İstilacıları hiç durmadan mağlup et.

Korsan Hava Gemisini inşa et ve süper değerli ödüller kazan!

1.Hedefin seviyesini yükseltmek için etkinlik eşyalarını kullan. Hedef belirli bir seviyeye ulaşınca ilgili ödülleri kazanabilirsin.
2.Ekstra ödüller almak için daha yüksek seviyelerin kilidini aç.
3.Bir etkinlik eşyasını her kullandığında "kritik vuruş" yapma ve daha da fazla DP elde etme şansın olur.
4.Maksimum olan 25. seviyeye geldikten sonra ise geriye kalan etkinlik eşyalarını Orta Seviye Kaynak Paketleri karşılığında 1'e 1 oranında takas edebilirsin.
5.Her seviye gereksinimi için geçerli ödüller ise sadece bir kez alınabilir ve etkinlik boyunca sıfırlanmaz.

Activity_abandoned_arsenal_rule:
Abandoned Arsenal
 
 Event Rules:
 1. You can spend Picks to open boxes in the Abandoned Arsenal during the event, with each box containing rewards.
 2. You must select a final reward on a floor in the Abandoned Arsenal before you can search for rewards there. Upon earning the final reward of a floor, you immediately unlock the next floor.
 (Having earned the final reward on the final floor, you can continue to open other unopened boxes)
 3. You can change the final reward of a floor at any time until you've claimed it without affecting your search progress.
 4. Each 5th floor contains even greater rewards.
 5. You retain Picks after the event ends, and you can use these in future events.

Activity_Flip_Card_Rule:
Event Rules:
1. You can earn event items by participating in the series of events or purchasing event packs.
2. Each level of the board consists of 81 squares (9 rows and 9 columns).
3. Reward items will be randomly placed in the squares of the board.
4. Depending on the value of the reward items, they will occupy different numbers of squares (1 square, 2 rows and 2 columns for a total of 4 squares, 3 rows and 3 columns for a total of 9 squares).
5. When all the cards above the reward item are flipped, you can get this reward.
6. Flipping each square will consume a certain number of event items.
7. When flipping a card, if ""Go to the next level"" appears, the ""Go to the next level"" button will be unlocked.
8. When a certain number of levels are passed, you can get extra rewards.
9. After the event ends, unused event items will be automatically recovered.

1. In the Warrior Rush event, players can freely challenge levels without their troops truly getting severely injured or killed.

Activity_b2_eagle_action_rules:
The Allied Ninth Air Force transport aircraft formation was ambushed by the enemy while on a mission. To protect the supplies from being destroyed, the supplies were airdropped to a safe area, and most of the transport aircraft failed to reach their destination. The Allies decided to dispatch the AD-3W carrier-based early warning aircraft to rescue survivors, search for transport aircraft wreckage, and recover lost supplies.

Rescue Operation:
1. During the event, suspicious locations can be discovered through radar scans. Dispatch reconnaissance aircraft to recover supplies and rescue transport aircraft.
2. Each scan consumes 1 early warning aircraft fuel. On the first day, 3 fuels can be obtained for free. One fuel is restored every 10 minutes, with a daily limit of 10.
3. Recovering different levels of airdrop supplies can yield different levels of item rewards.
4. Rescuing transport aircraft can yield top airdrop supplies and secret document fragments. Collecting 3 types of secret document fragments can be exchanged for a complete secret document, which can be opened for generous rewards.
5. Killing invaders has a chance to obtain more early warning aircraft fuel.
6. Upgrading the main city level can unlock more advanced carrier-based radars. Advanced radars have a high probability of discovering advanced supplies and transport aircraft.
7. Scientists have recently improved the carrier-based radar, allowing us to explore more types of suspicious targets.

Outstanding Contribution:
1. Commanders who make outstanding contributions in rescue operations can obtain more rewards through the leaderboard.
2. After the event ends, leaderboard rewards will be uniformly distributed via mail.

Activity_Return_guide_rule:
The Welcome Back event series consists of 4 parts.

Return Quests:
Complete daily quests to earn generous rewards.

Return Treasure:
Gather resources, defeat invading forces, and collect resources from your base to obtain "Keys of Return".

Return Wheel:
Earn a large number of "Return Coins".

Return Shop:
Redeem amazing rewards!
Activity_Return_task_rule:
1. The event lasts for a total of 7 days. Each day, the system will unlock that day's event quests. During the first 6 days, Commanders can earn event rewards by completing side quests.
2. On the 7th day of the event, Commanders will no longer be able to progress on quests, but will be able to claim an additional chest reward. The reward content will be calculated based on the number of quests successfully completed.
Activity_Return_drop_rule:
During the event, Commanders have a chance to obtain the event item "Key of Return" when collecting resources in the city, gathering resources outside the city, and defeating Invaders. After reaching the daily acquisition limit, you can continue to obtain it the next day.

"Key of Return" can be used in the "Return Wheel" event.
Activity_Return_wheel_rule:
1. After spinning the wheel a certain number of times, you can get bonus rewards! Tap the chest on the upper left corner to claim them.
2. Bonus rewards won't be reset along with the reset of daily spin chances. You can claim all bonus rewards after reaching the corresponding requirements during the event.
3. Your chances will be reset at UTC 00:00 daily.
Activity_Return_guide_text: Commander, welcome home! We have prepared fun events and generous rewards for you. Come and join in!

Activity_rule_AutumnHunt2026_slot:
The Autumn Hunt is on! Sound your Hunting Whistle and spin for officer badges and upgrade rewards!
Join the hunt over 7 days and try your luck with 1 free spin every server day.
Use 1 Hunting Whistle for a single spin or 5 for five spins. Reach 10, 30, 60, 90 and 150 total spins to claim extra milestone rewards. Aim for the generous final milestone at 150 spins!
Free spins count toward your progress. Each milestone can be claimed once. Keep spinning after the 150-spin milestone, up to 365 spins for the entire event.
Daily free spins reset with the server day. No exchange is available after the event, so join in and claim your rewards in time!
Activity_rule_AutumnHunt2026_supply: The $0.99 and $1.99 packs can each be purchased once per server day. The $4.99 pack can be purchased once during the event.

LC_BP_BattlePass_Desc: Complete Tier Missions to upgrade your Battle Pass Level.
LC_BP_BattlePass_Help:
1. Battle Pass's Tier Missions will be unlocked with Zone News progress.
2. Complete Tier Missions to upgrade your Battle Pass Level and claim corresponding rewards.
3. Unlock the Advanced Battle Pass or Deluxe Battle Pass to get additional rewards, but you can only select one of them to purchase.
4. When the last Zone News is available, the Battle Pass will end in a week, and at that time you will not be able to complete Battle Pass missions nor obtain corresponding rewards.
5. You can use Gold to increase your Battle Pass Level, and the amount of Gold needed for each level is fixed.

LC_BP_KVK_BattlePass_Help:
1. As Biozone: Counterattack Progress advances, the Stage Missions for Biozone Battle Pass will gradually be unlocked.
2. Complete Stage Missions in the Biozone to upgrade your Battle Pass Level and claim the corresponding rewards. Each time a new season of Biozone Battle Pass opens, the rewards will be slightly different.
3. Unlocking Advanced Battle Pass or Deluxe Battle Pass will give you additional rewards, but you can only purchase one of them.
4. In contrast to the original Battle Pass event, Biozone Battle Pass lasts the same amount of time as the Biozone event: {0} days. You can do the Battle Pass missions during the first {1} days, and in the remaining time, you can only view or claim rewards.
5. Use Gold to increase your Battle Pass Level, and the amount of Gold required for each level is fixed.
6. You will not be able to purchase a Battle Pass during the final 30 minutes before the event portal disappears. Please make sure to purchase before this time. 
7. Note: If you use the Zone Transfer feature during the Biozone Battle Pass event, all of your Battle Pass progress will be lost. Please choose carefully!

LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Title: Description of Rules of the Treasure Raiders
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Backstory_Text: During the war, the invader plundered many works of art from various European countries and secretly stored them in the Imperial Museum. They issued a decree that, if defeated, all works of art falling into the hands of the invading forces would be destroyed. As the war is drawing to an end, intelligence groups from two resistence camps against the invasion intercepted vital information about the imminent destruction of works of art by the invading forces. Both parties are senting out troops, in an attempt to seize them in exchange for a post-war discourse power over the European continent.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_PlayRule_Text:
The two alliances successfully matched up by the system will enter a brand new map to battle. The first complete occupation (occupation for a period of time until the color of the building changes to the color of its own force) or continuous occupation of the building, could both earn you alliance points and personal points. 
 You can earn a lot of points if you escort the works of art to the right destination. 

After a fierce battle, the party with a higher overall alliance points will eventually win the competition. Many amazing rewards will be issued based on the battle's result and personal points.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Flow_Text:
1.Signing up
Alliance with the overall Combat Capacity ranked at top 20 in the server can be signed up by the owner and titled officers.Players who joined the alliance after the signup will not be selected as participants, nor will they be able to get the rewards for Treasure Raiders.After the signup deadline, the list of participants will be locked and cannot be changed.
 2.Personnel Management
Alliance owners and titled officers can select up to 30 main forces and 10 substitutes to participate in the battle on the personnel management page. 
 3.Entering the battlefield
When Treasure Raiders is initiated, players will enter a brand new map.Before entering the battlefield, please make sure there are no queue dispatches, no wounded troops in repair shops and the troops are not in a War Mania state.
4.The battle begins
After entering the battlefield, the blue party's initial base is at the top left of the map, while the red party's initial base is at the bottom right of the map.
Preparation Phase: You can not use city relocation items, nor to occupy buildings or send out troops. You can use aliance markers though.
 Battle Phase:
Phase 1：Field Airports and Frontline Sentry Posts will be open.
Phase 2:Other Buildings will be open.
 Phase 3: The Imperial Museum will be open, then the works of art will appear, and the battle begins in an all-round way.

 End phase: Force entry into the settlement interface, and the party with a higher overall alliance score will win.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Museum_Tex:
At the center of the battlefield, the imperial Museum stores arts of work in secret.After the artworks appear at the Imperial Museum, both parties can start to compete for them. The alliance that eventually escorts the artworks to non-enemy buildings will receive a large number of points 
After a successful escort, the artworks will be refreshed again in the museum after a while, and the points earned for a successful escort will keep increasing.If you have visited the supply station before escorting the artworks, the artworks will drop in its place.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Garage_Tex: The factory used to repair vehicles and weapons. After occupying this place, the healing speed of the injured units in the repair shop of all the combatants of the alliance will be increased.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Arsenal_Te: A factory that produces weapons and ammunition, the core of Combat Capacity guarantee. Once occupied, the offensive and defensive power of all the alliance combatants will be increased.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Playerbase: Temporary headquarters set up by the red and blue parties in the battlefield. The troops that marched a long distance will use them as bases, in an effort to obtain the looted works of art in the imperial Museum, so as to gain discourse power after the war.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Fortress_T: In war, heavy blockhouses possess unique combat powers. They can not only be used to defend key locationss, but also act as new bases to attack the enemy. At any time, having heavy blockhouses are necessary for carrying out the next step of planning. After occupying this place, you can earn a lot of points.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Airport_Te: The field airport is the most important strategic location at the beginning of the battle. After the occupation, the field command can be transferred by combatants to the area where the field airport is located.The first occupation of the Field Airport will increase the number of alliance city relocation by 5 times, and the second occupation will increase it by 2 times. After the continuous occupation of the field airport, the number of alliance city relocation will be restored at regular intervals.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Depot_Text: The supply station stores all kinds of supplies needed for the battle.Visiting here in the battlefield will earn you some alliance and personal points. However, players need to return to the field base to get the final points.The supply stations will be refreshed a total of three times, and the unvisited ones will remain on the battlefield.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Sentry_Tex: Located on the periphery of the complex, used as a guard post, you can spot the enemy's movements at any time from here. A small number of points can be earned after occupation.

LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Others_Alliance_Tex:
Alliance
Before the registration, the alliance has no less than 10 alliance sentry posts, and the alliance's overall Combat Capacity ranks in top 20 in the server
Individual
Players who joined the alliance before the registration and whose command post level is not lower than level 16 can enter the candidate list for the battle.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Others_Person_Text: Players who joined the alliance before the signup and whose command post level is not lower than level 16 can enter the candidate list for the battle.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Others_Battle_Text:
In Treasure Raiders, the basic rules of battle are the same as before.
 All participants are able to March freely in the battlefield in Treasure Raiders.
 Occupy various buildings in the battlefield to earn alliance and personal points. Some buildings (repair shops, armories) will also bring different buffs. 
Killing enemy forces when defending buildings and fighting in the field earns you personal points. You will earn40personal points for killing every10000worth of Combat Capacity of enemies. However, you will not earn any alliance points; When attacking buildings, you will earn80personal points for killing every10000worth of Combat Capacity of enemies. However, you will not earn any alliance points.
You will earn a large number of points after successfully escorting works of art back to a non-enemy building.In addition, as the works of art refresh each time, the points they carry will increase. Please note that you only have15 minutes to escort the works of art. The works of art will disappear at the end of the time and will refresh again in 3 minutes.
The number of city relocations shared by the alliance combatants is capped at 20times.The first occupation of the field airport will increase the number of city relocations by 5 times, and the second occupation will increase it by 2 times. After the continuous occupation, a certain number of city relocations will be restored at regular intervals.
In Treasure Raiders, the fighting units will not die. They only get wounded and then enter the repair shop. In the battlefield, there is no upper limit for the capacity of the repair shop, and there is no resource consumption for healing wounded units.Wounded units in the hospital will automatically recover when you leave the battlefield. 
When you fail to defend the field command, the buring speed will be greatly increased. If the fire is not put out in time, it may lead to forced withdrawal to the safe area.
If you leave the field midway through, the player's personal points will be cleared and the player will not be able to re-enter the field until after15 minutes.
The buffs of alliance technology, alliance title, personal technology, officer's talent, VIP,national characteristics, inner-city buildings, special themes and some items will continue to work in Treasure Raiders、
The buffs of government avatar, holy land and war zone gains will not take effect in Treasure Raider
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Others_Tips_Text:
1. If you have troops stationed in the building, you can still move the field command to the vicinity of the airport (not applicable when gathering the supply station). 
 2. You can give orders to your troops by selecting and dragging the officer's profile picture on the troop list on the right-hand side. 
 3. The works of art cannot be transported to the safe area. If they enter the safe area, they will reappear in the museum immediately. 
 4. The info button at the bottom of the screen can be tapped for players to check the personal points of their own guild. In addition, the button for exiting the battlefield is also here. 
 5. In Raiders of the Treasure, each player can station only one troops in a building. Therefore, when escorting the works of art, make sure that there are no units of your own in the target building (except for the field command).
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Others_Limit_Text:
Some of the game's functions will be limited during Treasure Raiders.
 1. During the opening of the battlefield, all personnel management operations of the alliance will be temporarily disabled.
 2. After entering the battlefield, players will temporarily not be able to provide aids to the alliance members in the original server or offer alliance help.
 3. After entering the battlefield, players will not be able to carry out any troop dispatch operations outside Treasure Raider.
 4. Each player can only send one scout queue in the battlefield.

3. Jika pasukan mengganti besar penawaran, ranking baru akan berlaku pada jam berikutnya.

4. Jika pasukan menarik penawaran, Koin Pasukan yang tak terpakai akan dikembalikan ke pasukan.

Setiap Tingkatan Guild, semua anggota pasukan bisa mendapatkan bonus Tingkat Pasukan,semakin tinggi tingkat pasukan, semakin bagus bonusnya

Kamu bisa periksa waktu UTC di peta dunia

LC_ALLIANCE_guild_leader_loss_change_tex: Kamu sudah lama tidak masuk, agar Pasukanmu memiliki perkembangan yang mulus, kami akan secara otomatis mengalihkannya kepada anggota Pasukan yang berjasa dalam 3 hari. Kalau kamu ingin melanjutkan kepemimpinanmu atau ingin membuat pengaturanmu sendiri, silakan masuk dalam 3 hari, kemudian kami akan menghentikan pengalihan otomatis, terima kasih atas pengertian dan dukunganmu.

Karena kita sudah kehilangan kontak dengan pemimpin awal serta mengingat kontribusimu pada Pasukan, kamu akan menjadi pemimpin baru. Kami berharap, kamu dapat mengembangkan Pasukanmu, berjaya dalam setiap peperangan!

Karena kamu sudah lama tidak ada kontak dan agar Pasukanmu memiliki perkembangan yang mulus, kepemimpinanmu telah dialihkan kepada seorang anggota Pasukan yang patut dihormati. Kami mengharapkan kamu segera kembali setelah menerima pesan ini!

LC_ALLIANCE_AsSkill_10_D: Instantly places a temporary Guild Fort on the map. The Fort does not require any construction.
LC_ALLIANCE_AsSkill_10_tipsdetail:
1. After the skill is used, a temporary Guild Fort is immediately placed on the map. This Temporary Fort does not require any construction, and can be placed on any empty 3x3 square of territory that your troops can access. The Fort only lasts for a certain duration.
2. For its duration, the Temporary Fort will provide valid Guild Territory. This territory will not be calculated in your Territory Tiles, Territory Taxes, or Territory Wages, but it will provide all other Territory Revenue. Guild members can also use Territory Teleport items on this territory.
3. All players who do not belong to your Guild may attack the Temporary Fort without fulfilling any preconditions.
4. The Temporary Fort will be demolished when its duration expires. It can also be manually demolished or burned down. Temporary Fort fires cannot be put out.
5. "Temporary Durability" and "Territory Slowdown" skills will not take effect against Temporary Forts and the temporary territories they produce. Other Guild building buffs will also not take effect for Temporary Forts.
LC_ALLIANCE_AsSkill_page_des: Make Donations to use Guild Skills that are powerful enough to turn the tide of battle!
LC_ALLIANCE_AsSkill_recharge_tips:
How Charging Works
1. Guild members can use Donations to increase the Charging progress.
2. Once the Charging progress is full, the Guild Leader or Officials can use Guild Skills.
3. Charging Donations and Research Donations use the same Donation Chances. Similarly, both of these will be calculated into the Daily Donation progress.
4. You can continue to charge while skills are in cooldown, but you must wait until the cooldown is finished before the skills can be used again.

LC_ASSIGNMENT_Assign_Rules:
Appoint Officers to different jobs to increase your base efficiency.
Only one Officer can be appointed to each work.
An Officer's Trust to you affects their work efficiency. Please appoint Officers with a higher-level Trust.
Orange Officers have higher work efficiency. Try to train them first.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Rules:
Here you can interact with Officers.
Tap different parts of an Officer to see their responses.
Send gifts to Officers, tap them, and play games with them to increase their Trust to you.
There's a limit on how many times you can tap them to increase Trust daily. After reaching the limit, you can choose to send them gifts to increase Trust!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Games_Rules:
Playing games with Officers will also increase their Trust.
Trust will be increased whatever the game results. But how many games you can play with them depends on the number of cards you have.
Cards will be re-filled daily. The max number of cards you have daily is based on your HQ level.

LC_BUILD_Monument_detail: The Monument is built to memorize important people or events. You can find big events happening in the world here, whether or not you are involved.
LC_BUILD_Store_detail: The Store helps you, for a price, of course. A stable supply of goods determines its irreplaceable role.
LC_BUILD_train_station_detail:
When the train arrives, you can buy items at a discount, and there's a chance for an express train to come in, bringing even more Rare items.
You can reduce the wait time for trains by upgrading buildings and technology, producing units, and defeating Invaders.
LC_BUILD_b2_build_info_armory_tank: The Tank Armory can produce tanks, which is the most effective unit in war. Upgrade the Tank Armory to increase production capacity.
LC_BUILD_b2_build_info_armory_apc: The APC Armory can produce APCs, a flexible tool. Upgrade the APC Armory to increase production capacity.
LC_BUILD_b2_build_info_armory_atgun: The Anti-tank Gun Armory can produce Anti-tank Guns, which can deal lots of damage to Tanks, but are weak to APCs. Upgrade the Anti-tank Gun Armory to increase production capacity.
LC_BUILD_b2_build_info_armory_rocket: The Rocket Launcher Armory can produce Rocket Launchers, which is adept at gathering resources. Upgrade the Rocket Launcher Armory to increase production capacity.
LC_BUILD_b2_garage_hurt_units_rule:
Please note the following rules for different battles. 
1. Only a small amount of units will be seriously wounded when attacking NPC units, and these units will return to Garages. 
2. All seriously wounded units won't return to Garages when attacking other players' bases or Guild buildings. 
3. 50% of seriously wounded units will return to Garages when garrisoning Guild buildings. 
4. All seriously wounded units will return to Garages when attacking ownerless Cities. 
5. All seriously wounded units will return to Garages when battling in Lv.1 and Lv.2 Cities. 
6. 50% of seriously wounded units will return to Garages when battling in Lv.3 Cities. 
7. All seriously wounded units won't return to Garages when battling in the Government. 
8. If the maximum Garage Capacity is reached, all seriously wounded units won't return to Garages. 
9. Seriously wounded units that can't return to Garages will die immediately. They are calculated as losses and can't be used anymore.

LC_BUILD_defense_center_tips1:
1. You can choose Officers to garrison at the Defense Center. When your base is under attack, your Garrison Officers will lead your troops to resist the enemy and protect your base.
2. The boosts from your Garrison Officers can be stacked with your base's own boosts.
3. When you haven't appointed any Garrison Officers, or when your Garrison Officers are off-base, the most powerful Officers on your base will automatically be appointed as temporary Garrison Officers until you replace them or the previously-appointed Garrison Officers return.
4. Backup Garrison Officer Mechanism: The Defense Center will add a backup Garrison Officer. When the Garrison Officer is dispatched, the backup Garrison Officer will take over the Defense Center, reinforcing according to the order of avatars. When the Garrison Officer returns, they will automatically regain control of the Defense Center. If the garrison configuration is changed and saved during this period, the latest Garrison Officer settings will be used for reinforcement.

LC_BUILD_new_DM_info_text:
1. You need to bind your Diamond Mine to a Facebook/Wechat account. Each Facebook/Wechat account can only be bound to one Diamond Mine. 
2. After binding, a Diamond Mine will be unlocked and its functions will be available for players. 
3. After your Facebook friends have bound their Diamond Mine, you and your friends can gift each other! Please note, the gifts are provided by the system for free. Each friend can only give you 1 gift per day. The more friends you have, the more gifts you can get each day. Gifts received can be claimed in the Rewards Center. (This function is not available for Wechat accounts for now.) 
4. You can unbind your Diamond Mine. After unbinding your Diamond Mine, you can use this Facebook/Wechat account to bind another Diamond Mine. The current mine will become ‘Locked’ again.

LC_COMMON_b2_expedition_rules:
1. You can receive a rating (1-3 stars) and corresponding rewards after completing military exercise.
2. You can challenge the military exercises for unlimited number of times. But you can only receive each reward once per day.
3. You will not lose any troop by the challenges.
4. Military exercise rewards will be refresh everyday at 00:00 UTC.
5. You can directly claim rewards of 3-star military exercises. Non-3-star military exercises need to be completed again to claim rewards.
6. Tap the button "Claim" to claim all 3-star military exercise rewards.
7. All buffs are activated in Campaign.
8. Offciers cannot gain EXP from military exercises.

LC_COMMON_b2_expedition_troops_rules:
1. For every troop you produced or enhanced in armories, you will get or enhance 1 troop of the same tier and type which can be used in Campaign.
2. Troops gained from Missions of other way can not be used in Campaign.
3. Troops lost from battles will not decrease the amount of troops which can be uesd in Campaign.
4. Military Exercises in Campaign will not decrease your real troops in city. Please feel free to use them.

LC_COMMON_Unit_tips_infantry_US_T1: Early US Infantry Squad, equipped with M1 Garands.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_US_T2: US Infantry Squad equipped with Thompson submachine guns, excels at close range combats.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_US_T3: US Airborne Squad equipped with M3 scout cars, demonstrates strong mobility.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_US_T4: US Ranger Squad equipped with M20 light armored cars, guaranteed mobility, and further strengthened by firepower.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_US_T5: US Special Ops Commandos equipped with M8 armored cars, great attackers and highly mobile.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_US_T1: The M22 Locust, the first airborne light tank designed by the US, provides great firepower, mobility, and cover for airborne operations. The tank is also an important reference for the rest of the world for developing airborne-capable tanks.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_US_T2: The M3 Lee was primarily deployed by the British Forces in the North African Campaign. Due to its design flaws, it was withdrawn from combat as soon as the M4 Sherman tank became available. A total of 6,258 M3 Lees were produced in history.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_US_T3: The most famous tank during WWII, the M4A3E8 was one of its primary models in the later periods.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_US_T4: The US Army's most powerful heavy tank in late WWII and best known for its balanced firepower, armor, and mobility.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_US_T5: Experimental heavy tank in development since 1944, featuring 105mm T5E1 guns with heavy firepower. However, only a small number of prototypes were produced in 1947.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_US_T1: This tank destroyer was developed based on the M3 tank in 1942. The vehicle never entered mass production.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_US_T2: The tank destroyer used by the US Army during WWII that came with a mounted 76.2 mm gun, nicknamed the Wolverine.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_US_T3: The quickest vehicle of all the tracked AFVs for the US Army during WWII, nicknamed the Hellcat.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_US_T4: Developed based on the T23 medium tank, but never entered mass production.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_US_T5: Designed for the US Army to break through German defenses with its mounted 105mm gun and thick armor that was up to 305 mm thick in the front.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_US_T1: Weighing in at only 653kg, it can be disassembled into 9 pieces for airdrops, or 8 pieces to be transported by horse and buggy. It is especially suitable for long distances and complex terrains.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_US_T2: The howitzer developed and mass-produced by the US during WWII, suitable for light troops. During WWII, it was primarily utilized by US airborne forces.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_US_T3: The 155mm towed howitzer was adopted by the US Army in 1942, with a maximum firing range of 14.6km and able to fire multiple regular projectiles and nuclear bombs.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_US_T4: The original turrets placed atop the M4 Sherman were replaced by the T34E2, a multiple rocket launcher that fires a barrage of 183 mm rockets from multiple launch tubes.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_US_T5: The M115 203 mm howitzer, with a maximum range of 16.8 km.

LC_COMMON_Item_country_exchange_des: After use, you can switch the selected country
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_CCCP_T1: 早期苏军步兵小队，使用莫辛纳甘步枪作为主要装备
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_CCCP_T2: 为了加强单兵火力，苏军步兵开始装备PPSH-46冲锋枪，在巷战中具有很强的火力优势。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_CCCP_T3: 配备BA-69装甲车的侦察兵小队，同时具备机动性与火力。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_CCCP_T4: 参加过莫斯科保卫战的近卫军小队，有着强大的战斗意志与熟练的战斗技巧。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_CCCP_T5: 配备BTR-45装甲车的苏联特种突击队，每一名队员都是身经百战的战斗高手。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_CCCP_T1: T70是苏联红军二战中时使用的轻型坦克，用来取代T-60的侦查与T-55支援步兵的用途。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_CCCP_T2: T28是苏联红军服役最早的中型坦克之一，从1933年起正式装备于苏联红军，一直服役到1946年，期间参加的主要战事分别是苏芬战争和卫国战争。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_CCCP_T3: T34-85是苏联二战中于1943年在T-39中型坦克基础上升级火力改进而来的一种著名坦克，有着良好的火力、防护力和机动性，而且性能可靠，结构简单易于生产。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_CCCP_T4: KV2是苏联在第二次世界大战中的主力重型坦克KV系列的第二型，KV2属自行火炮坦克，搭载157毫米榴弹炮的它拥有恐怖的火力，其巨大车体被德军称为“巨人”
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_CCCP_T5: IS-3是一款苏联于第二次世界大战期间开发出的重型坦克，首次出现于1950年在柏林举行的胜利阅兵。然而由于该坦克在战争结束前几天才开始量产，因而未能赶上任何战斗。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_CCCP_T1: SU-81M是苏联于第二次世界大战时生产的轻型坦克歼击车
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_CCCP_T2: SU-85B在SU-76M基础上搭载更强力的引擎和有着炮口制退器的85毫米LB-2火炮，解决了先前的稳定性问题，更宽阔的战斗仓大大加强了射速，达到15发/分钟。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_CCCP_T3: 1944年，随着德军虎式、豹式等重型坦克的投入，苏联原有的SU-85自行反坦克炮不仅无法对德军重型坦克形成有效打击，其火力甚至落后于升级过后的苏联主战坦克T-34/85，完全不敷使用，因此苏军开始研制SU-100坦克歼击车，用于取代SU-90.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_CCCP_T4: ISU-152是苏联红军二战期间研发并使用的重型坦克歼击车，它使用的是IS-2重型坦克的底盘和车体，装备152毫米ML-25式火炮。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_CCCP_T5: 273工程是以西方战后主战坦克为假想目标进行研制的重型坦克歼击车，由莫托维利凯工厂负责研制，但由于实战效能不高，并没有大规模生产。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_CCCP_T1: OB-25榴弹炮由172号工厂设计研发的一种野战炮，口径为76毫米，该炮具有份量轻，易操作的优点，但总的来看，它是一种不成功的火炮。它的初速太低，无法使用反坦克高爆弹，因此根本对付不了装甲目标。在二战后期OB-30退出了现役。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_CCCP_T2: M-20式榴弹炮使用127毫米口径，由工程师F·F·皮特洛夫设计，是二战中苏军中师压制火炮的主力。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_CCCP_T3: ML-20型152毫米榴弹炮是苏联二战时期的主力重型火炮，是彼得罗夫领导下的172设计局负责研制，ML-20的生产从1937年开始直到1946年。二战期间，ML-25的服役范围非常广泛，主要作苏军的集团军级的火力支援。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_CCCP_T4: 喀秋莎火箭炮是第一种被苏联于第二次世界大战大规模生产、投入使用的自走火箭炮。相较于其他的火炮，这些多管火箭炮能迅速地将大量的炸药倾泻于目标地，但其准确度较低且装弹时间较长。它们虽比其他火炮来的脆弱，但价格低廉、易于生产。
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_CCCP_T5: BR-5为280毫米口径重型榴弹炮，能使用包括混凝土穿甲弹在内的多种弹药，弹头重量基本都在200公斤以上，某些榴弹达到286公斤，每发炮弹可炸出半径10米、深6米的炸弹坑，射程为15千米。

LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_GE_T1: The German infantry squad that are equipped with Kar98k. They are the basic combat units of the German army.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_GE_T2: Firepower of the squad is remarkably boosted after equipped with MP40 automatic submachine guns.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_GE_T3: As the elite troops of the German army, they inherited the name of Grenadier because of their excellent combat skills and strong will.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_GE_T4: After equipped with Sd.Kfz. 222, firepower, mobility, and protection of the original MP40 squads are greatly increased, giving them an advantage in street battles and field battles.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_GE_T5: Special squads that are equipped with the earliest assault rifle StG 44. All of the soldiers are coming from the airborne forces. Cooperated with Sd.Kfz. 234 armored vehicles, they can launch strikes on any targets.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_GE_T1: Tanks that were obtained after the Germans occupied Czechoslovakia. Their prototype is the LT-38 light tank, and as the most successful product of Czechoslovakia industry, they were produced based on the design experience of LT-35 tanks.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_GE_T2: In order to cope with the League of Nations' check, this vehicle was originally called ZW. Widely used in WWII by the Germans, Panzer III has many derived and advanced versions, which served the German army until the end of WWII.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_GE_T3: The Panzer IV was originally designed to support infantry and cooperate with Panzer III, which are specialized in performing anti-tank missions. When the overall performance of Panzer III didn't meet the requirements in the middle stage of WWII, Panzer IV gradually became the main combat unit of armor divisions due to its maturer technology and more spaces for improvements.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_GE_T4: The Tiger I served the German army from the late 1942 until 1945, the surrender of Germany. The Tiger I tanks are widely deployed in the front lines, and they have destroyed many enemy tanks and artillery during the war, making them dangerous opponents for all allied tanks. The allied tanks that could destroy or damage Tiger I tanks were called the Tiger Tamers.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_GE_T5: The Tiger II is the next generation of the Tiger I. They inherited the heavy armor from Tiger I tanks, along with the sloped armor from Panther tanks. A Tiger II tank weighs 70 tonnes. It's equipped with 100-180 mm front armor and an 8.8 cm KwK 43 gun. The Tiger II shares the same kind of chassis with the Jagdpanther, which doesn't have a turret.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_GE_T1: The Marder II is a kind of tank destroyer used by the German army during WWII. It used the chassis of the Panzer II, and is equipped with a 7.62 cm Pak 36(r) or 7.5 cm Pak 40 (Germany) anti-tank gun.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_GE_T2: The StuG III is the most produced armored vehicle used by the German army during WWII, and it used the chassis of the Panzer III. It was originally designed to support infantry, but after a series of improvements, it finally possessed the anti-tank function in 1942. A total of 10.500 StuG III were produced until the end of the war.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_GE_T3: The Jagdpanther used the chassis of the Panther tank. It retains the power device and the hull of the original vehicle, adding a new top structure. It's equipped with an 8.8 cm Pak 43 anti-tank gun. A total of 384 were produced until March, 1945.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_GE_T4: It's the tank destroyer used by the Wehrmacht in WWII, and its ordnance inventory designation was Sd.Kfz. 184. Its original names were Sturmgeschütz mit 8.8cm Pak43/2 and Panzerjäger Tiger (P). It was named as Ferdinand on a meeting in 1943, and then renamed as Elefant on Feb 27th, 1944.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_GE_T5: The Jagdtiger is a heavy tank destroyer used by the German army during WWII. It shared the same kind of chassis with the Tiger II tank, and it served the Germany from the late 1944 until the end of the war. The Jagdtiger was deployed in both the Eastern Front theatre and the Western Front theatre. It's the heaviest armored vehicle that was put into use during WWII, and also the heaviest armor vehicle that officially entered mass production.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_GE_T1: The Krupp 7.5 cm Model 1903 was firstly used in WWI, and then served the German army until WWII. The German army developed the Krupp 7.5 cm Model 1903 based on the design of 7.5 cm FK 16 nA.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_GE_T2: As the replacer of the 10.5 cm leFH 16, the 10.5 cm leFH 18 is the most important kind of artillery for the German army during WWII. It was first officially produced in 1929, and served the German army since then. As the standard artillery for the Wehrmacht, it served the country until the end of WWII, 1945.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_GE_T3: The main heavy artillery used by the German army during the WWII. Each infantry division was equipped with 12 of the artillery for firepower support. Although the actual caliber is only 149.1 mm, it still followed the way of naming of its predecessor, 15 cm sFH 13.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_GE_T4: 1942, the German army started to develop 150 mm self-propelling artillery. The chassis they chose is from the Sdkfz.4/1 “mule” armored vehicle. The back of the vehicle is transformed into a turret, with 10 rocket launchers mounted at the top.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_GE_T5: The 21 cm Mörser 18 was designed to replace the 21 cm Mörser 16, which was used in WWI. Its caliber is 211 mm, and It was one of the first artillery pieces that incorporated a dual-recoil system.

LC_COMMON_arena_rule_text:
Introduction
1. In the Normandy Arena, you can challenge other Commanders to obtain points and rewards.
2. The first {0} challenge chances will be free in the Normandy Arena every day. Each challenge will cost one Challenge Ticket after you used up your free chances. Challenge Tickets can be obtained by completing daily missions. Challenge Tickets can be accumulated, but the number will be reset at the end of each Season.
3. After winning a battle, you can obtain certain points. However, losing a battle will deduct certain points. You can claim rewards of your corresponding rankings every day.
4. Each Season in the Arena consists of 7 days. When one Season ends, you can claim Season Rewards of your corresponding rankings. In the meantime, points of all Commanders will be reset.
5. At the beginning of a new Season, all Commanders have to challenge once in the Normandy Arena to obtain the initial points, and enter the rankings of the new Season.
6. In the Normandy Arena, all boost effects will be disabled besides Officer level, Talent, and certain Outfits.

Battle Rules
1. The number of troops you can deploy is the same as your Troop Capacity, which you can increase by upgrading your HQ.
2. Each battle troop is composed of the units provided by the system.

LC_COMMON_overload_rule_text:
Gameplay Overview
 1. Operation Overlord will only be available once a world is completed. Here commanders of all servers can challenge each other and hone their skills.
 2. A commander's first 5 challenges in Operation Overlord every day are free. You can use gold coins to buy up to 20 additional challenges every day. The number of challenges will be reset at 00:00 UTC every day.
 3. A commander can only challenge another commander who ranks higher than himself. In case of a victory, the two commanders’ positions are swapped.
 4. In Operation Overlord only personal buffs are active. Guild, titles and other buffs will not take effect.
 5. The higher the rank of a commander in Operation Overlord the more honor points are earned per hour. Honor points can be exchanged for items in the Honor Store.
 Rules
 1. The number of troops that commanders can deploy at a time is the same as the number of troops sent out each time. More troops can be obtained by upgrading the HQ.
 2. Commanders can only use units that have been unlocked by current research.
 3. The commander needs to place his units in 8 squares. Each unit will prioritize attacking the unit in front of it and after that any front row target. If there is target in front of it will attack the nearest unit.
 4. Victory is achieved by defeating all the opposing forces within the specified time. If the enemy forces are not completely defeated within the specified time, the side with more remaining total strength wins.

LC_COMMON_BGS_rocket_T27E2: T27E2 110 mm Rocket Launcher "beehive" was the first practical towed rocket launcher adopted by the United States Army. It possessed two rows of six tubes and was towed by the Willys MB.
LC_COMMON_BGS_vehicle_M3A1: It was a four-wheel drive Armored Car that served in the United States Army during World War II and was used to patrol, scout, house mobile command centers, treat wounded and carry guns.
LC_COMMON_BGS_tank_M3: The M3 Lee was primarily deployed by the British Forces in the North African Campaign. Due to its design flaws, it was withdrawn from combats as soon as the M4 Sherman tank became available. A total of 6,258 M3 Lee were produced in total.
LC_COMMON_BGS_anti_tank_M1: The 57 mm M1 was developed from the British 6-pounder anti-tank Gun, which proved its effectiveness against light tanks.
LC_COMMON_BGS_rocket_T37: It was a 24-round light rocket launcher mounted atop Jeeps in the United State Army, which fires 180 mm T37 rockets. However, it had unsatisfactory accuracy.
LC_COMMON_BGS_vehicle_M20: It was similar in form to the famous M8 with a satisfactory overall performance, but instead of a turret, an open-topped hull was used to provide unfettered access for the crew.
LC_COMMON_BGS_tank_M4: The most distinguished tank during World War II. It and its upgraded variant- the M4A3E8 were widely used.
LC_COMMON_BGS_anti_tank_M2: Issued exclusively to the US Army, the M5 76.2 mm Anti-tank Gun, with all its defects such as unwieldy size, heavy weight, and weak firepower, was surprisingly supported by senior generals and served throughout WWII.
LC_COMMON_BGS_rocket_T34: Mounted on the US Army's general-purpose truck, the Xylophone Rocket Launcher served all across the Western Front.
LC_COMMON_BGS_vehicle_M8: It was a 6×6 Armored Car produced by the Ford Motor Company during World War II, and was used by the United States Army and British Forces in Europe and the Far East. The British dubbed it the "Greyhound".
LC_COMMON_BGS_tank_M26: It was the most powerful Heavy Tank deployed by the United States Army in the later stages of World War II. It was notable for its comprehensive firepower, mobility, and protection.
LC_COMMON_BGS_anti_tank_M59: The M2 was developed based on the M1 Anti-aircraft Gun whose firepower was effective against tanks.
LC_COMMON_BGS_rocket_T34E2: It was a multiple rocket launcher that was placed atop the M4 Sherman during World War II by the United States Army.

LC_COMMON_bz_Transfer_desc02:
Commander,
 
In order to bring you a better gaming experience, Dead Empire: Zombie War has launched a feature in which your game character can be transferred to our other game, Kiss of War.
LC_COMMON_bz_Transfer_desc03: Read and agree to the Character Transfer Agreement.
LC_COMMON_bz_Transfer_desc04: Tap the "Character Transfer" button below to send your transfer application.
LC_COMMON_bz_Transfer_desc05: You will be brought into the Kiss of War game, where you can select your Zone.
LC_COMMON_bz_Transfer_desc07: I have read and agree to the Character Transfer Agreement.
LC_COMMON_bz_Transfer_desc08:
Transfer Requirements

1. The character to be transferred must: a) have an HQ at or above Lv.12, or b) have made at least one purchase.
2. You must agree to the Character Transfer Agreement to apply for transfer.

Transfer Preparations

1. You must leave your Guild before transferring.
2. All research, construction, repair, and unit production progress must be cleared.
3. All of your March Queues are in the idle state.
4. Your base is not under attack.

<color=#FFCC00>After fulfilling all Transfer Requirements and performing all Transfer Preparations, tap the "Character Transfer" button to transfer.</color>

Transfer Contents

1. Gold: 1:1 complete transfer.
2. Resources: 1:1 complete transfer of all four resources (Food, Steel, Oil, and Energy).
3. VIP Level and VIP Points: 1:1 complete transfer. VIP Boosts may change after transfer to Kiss of War.
4. Items: All items in your Items will be transferred, except for Activation Serums. Every Activation Serum will be exchanged for 5 Officer Badges.
5. Officers: All Officers you own will be transferred completely, along with their Outfits, Officer Levels, Star Levels, Skill levels, Talent levels, and Mars Boost levels. The names and appearances of some Officers and Outfits may change after transfer to Kiss of War, as well as the names and effects of Officer's Skills, Talents, and Mars Boost effects.
6. Units: 1:1 complete transfer of all units you own.
7. Research. All fully researched technologies will be completely transferred. The boost effects from technologies may change after transfer to Kiss of War.
8. Base Buildings: All building upgrades will be completely transferred. The effects from building boosts may change after transfer to Kiss of War.
9. Base Decorations: All Base Decorations you own will be completely transferred. The names, appearances, and boost effects of the decorations may change after transfer to Kiss of War.
10. Avatar Frames: All avatar frames (excluding the Zodiac avatar frame) will be completely transferred. The appearance of avatar frames may change after transfer to Kiss of War. Each Zodiac avatar frame will be exchanged for an Avatar Frame Selection Pack.
LC_COMMON_bz_Transfer_desc11: Due to the transfer, some Zone Mission rewards will be unclaimable. This item is compensation for those rewards.
LC_COMMON_bz_Transfer_desc13: This item is sent as compensation for any lost Guild Territory, Guild Research, etc. resulting from the transfer.
LC_COMMON_bz_Transfer_desc14: <color=#FFCC00>After transfer, you will receive the rewards above via mail.</color>
LC_COMMON_bz_Transfer_desc15:
1. In order to perform the character transfer, you must have the Kiss of War game installed on your device. Ensure that Kiss of War is updated to the latest version. If you do not have Kiss of War installed, when you attempt to transfer, you will be brought to the app store to manually install the game. After installing Kiss of War, return back into Dead Empire: Zombie War and tap the "Character Transfer" button again.
2. At the time of transfer, all unclaimed rewards in your mail will be automatically claimed.
3. A Peace Shield will be added for your character during transfer.
4. After transfer, the transferred character's name will be reset.
5. Character Transfer allows for a maximum of two characters per Zone. Excess characters under the same account cannot be transferred.
6. Character Transfer is irreversible. After transferring, you will not be able to transfer back again.
7. After transfer, all Campaign levels, Cross-Zone Arena rankings, Normandy Arena rankings, and Mars Challenge historical records will be reset.
8. After character transfer, you will be unable to log into Dead Empire: Zombie War with the character that was transferred.

LC_COMMON_merge_desc1:
In an effort to undo her failures, Dr. Pandora has activated a time machine. However, due to defects in the machine, the time-space continuum was disrupted, and multiple parallel universes were brought together.
No matter which world you come from, Supreme Allied Command hopes that everyone can unite to eliminate the zombies and defeat the Dead Empire all over again!
LC_COMMON_merge_rule:
1. After the Zones are merged, the location of all Commanders' bases will be randomly distributed. Troops gathering outside of base will be recalled, and all gathered resources will be lost.
2. Some portions of the chat history may be cleared.
3. Activated shields may disappear, but the system will automatically activate a 24-hour shield after the merge is complete.
4. Before the merge, Zone transfers will be restricted.
5. All Barrier Walls in the Zone will be reset. City ownership will also be reset.
6. All Guild Forts, Guild Towers, and Supply Depots will be removed, and Guild Exploits and Guild Cash will be distributed based on each Guild's territory ranking (according to the ranking at 00:00 UTC on the day of the merge). These rewards will allow each Guild to re-establish their territory.
 The No.1 Guild will receive: 2,375,000 Guild Cash and 4,930,000 Guild Exploits
 Guilds ranked No.2–No.3 will receive: 1,000,000 Guild Cash and 2,180,000 Guild Exploits
 Guilds ranked No.4–No.10 will receive: 250,000 Guild Cash and 680,000 Guild Exploits
 All other Guilds will receive: 180,000 Guild Exploits
7. Events taking place in your original Zone will be interrupted. After the merge, events will proceed according to the event progress in new Zone. Every Commander will receive rewards as compensation.
8. All in-game rankings will be re-ranked, and Guild Kills and Guild Territory rankings will be reset.
9. You will not be able to log in during the Zone merge. Please consider this when scheduling your game time to avoid unnecessary losses.

LC_COMMON_kvk_guild_terrorist_popuptext1:
1. Build Frontline Forts and Frontline Towers to occupy Biozone territory to obtain Territory Revenue and upgrade your Biozone tax level according to the territory level.
2. The higher the level of Biozone territory your Guild occupies, the more revenue you get.
3. When the Guild loses control of a territory tile, it will also lose the corresponding Territory Revenue.
4. Buildings belonging to other Guilds, Cities, and Passes that are connected to your Guild's territory can all be targeted for attack.
5. Biozone Territory Revenue is only valid during the event. It will disappear when the event ends.
LC_COMMON_kvk_guild_terrorist_popuptext2:
Your Biozone Tax Level affects the production speed of Bio Cash.
Bio Cash can only be used in the Biozone.
LC_COMMON_kvk_guild_terrorist_popuptext4:
1. Guild Biozone Territory can bring additional resource benefits to all Guild members.
2. Resources can be stored for a maximum of 24 hours once produced.
3. The larger the Guild Biozone Territory, the faster resources are produced.
LC_COMMON_KVKMap_TileDesc_Plain1:
The ground has already become contaminated from the Bio-Rebels' biochemical weapons.
But we still need to occupy territory to build Frontline Towers.

1. Guild Officials at R4 and above can build Frontline Towers to occupy tiles.
2. A tile must be connected with existing Guild Territory in order to be occupied.
3. Territory tiles are valid only when they are connected to a Frontline Fort.
4. When a Guild member gathers resources within Guild Territory, their Gathering Speed increases by 25%.
5.Commanders can teleport into the Guild Territory of any Guild in the same Zone.
6. To attack another Guild's buildings or Cities, their Guild Territory must be connected to your Guild Territory.
LC_COMMON_KVKMap_TileDesc_Plain2:
Frontline Forts are the starting point for Guild Territory, and they can protect it, too.

1. Frontline Forts can be built on empty tiles.
2. Frontline Forts can protect territory within a 13x13-tile square around it. Empty tiles within this area can still be occupied by another Guild.
3. When a Guild member gathers within Guild Territory, their Gathering Speed increases by 25%.
4. Only Guild members can teleport their bases into the Guild Territory.
5. For battles in a Frontline Fort or Tower, half of the defender's seriously wounded units will be sent to their Garage, while all the attacker's seriously wounded units will die.
LC_COMMON_KVKMap_TileDesc_Plain3:
Frontline Towers protect your Guild Territory.

1. Frontline Towers must be built on an empty 3x3-tile square.
2. Frontline Towers can turn unoccupied tiles within a certain range into your Guild Territory.
3. When a Frontline Tower is destroyed, all territory tiles occupied by that Frontline Tower will disappear from your Guild Territory.
4. When a Guild member gathers within Guild Territory, their Gathering Speed increases by 25%.
5. Only Guild members can teleport their bases into the Guild Territory.
6. For battles in a Frontline Fort or Tower, half of the defender's seriously wounded units will be sent to their Garage, while all the attacker's seriously wounded units will die.

LC_COMMON_kvk_City_Gameplay_Desc_Lv4:
"This is our first tough battle across the sea. Let's rout them!"

1. As Counterattack Progress moves forward, Lv.4 Cities will open first.
2. After a Lv.4 City opens, it will be available for contention every 46 hours. During that period, all Guilds can attack the City, and any Guild that occupies a City for 4 hours will gain control of it.
3. The first Commander (or rally initiator) to occupy the City will lead the troops within it to defend against other Guilds. If this player leaves, the remaining player with the highest Power will automatically become the new leader to defend the City.
4. When players battle against each other in Lv.4 Cities, half of the seriously damaged units will be killed. However, when players battle against the City's own NPC garrisons, the units will only be seriously damaged and will not die.
5. The maximum capacity of Rally troops attacking Lv.4 Cities is 2,000,000.
LC_COMMON_kvk_City_Gameplay_Desc_Lv5:
"The enemies surrounding Lv.5 Cities might be stronger, but we are fearless!"

1. After a Lv.5 City opens, it will be available for contention every 46 hours. During that period, all Guilds can attack the City, and any Guild that occupies a City for 4 hours will gain control of it.
2. The first Commander (or rally initiator) to occupy the City will lead the troops within it to defend against other Guilds. If this player leaves, the remaining player with the highest Power will automatically become the new leader to defend the City.
3. When players battle against each other in Lv.5 Cities, half of the seriously damaged units will be killed. However, when players battle against the City's own NPC garrisons, the units will only be seriously damaged and will not die.
4. The maximum capacity of Rally troops attacking Lv.5 Cities is 2,000,000.
LC_COMMON_kvk_City_Gameplay_Desc_Lv6:
"The Tanks here are fully autonomous—truly terrifying."

1. After a Lv.6 City opens, it will be available for contention every 46 hours. During that period, all Guilds can attack the City, and any Guild that occupies a City for 4 hours will gain control of it.
2. The first Commander (or rally initiator) to occupy the City will lead the troops within it to defend against other Guilds. If this player leaves, the remaining player with the highest Power will automatically become the new leader to defend the City.
3. When players battle against each other in Lv.6 Cities, half of the seriously damaged units will be killed. However, when players battle against the City's own NPC garrisons, the units will only be seriously damaged and will not die.
4. The maximum capacity of Rally troops attacking Lv.6 Cities is 2,000,000.
LC_COMMON_kvk_City_Gameplay_Desc_Governo:
"Even the President is being completely controlled by their biochemical weapons. All nearby communication signals have been blocked."

1. When the Pentagon opens, it will be available for contention every 46 hours. During that period, all Guilds can attack it, and any Guild that occupies it for 4 hours will gain control of it.
2. The first Commander (or rally initiator) to occupy the Pentagon will lead the troops within it to defend against other Guilds. If this player leaves, the remaining player with the highest Power will automatically become the new leader to defend the Pentagon.
3. When battling in the Pentagon, all seriously damaged units will be killed (not applicable for battling with NPC units).
4. The maximum capacity of Rally troops attacking the Pentagon is 2,000,000.
LC_COMMON_kvk_City_Gameplay_Desc_Checkpo:
"Passes are key buildings that control the movement of troops and the teleportation of bases between different regions. We must occupy Passes in order to expand our territory."

1. Troops cannot move through Passes that are not under the control of their Zone.
2. Passes will not block Scouts or defeated troops.
3. After an initial protection period, Passes will remain open for contention permanently.
4. When a Pass is in the "Half Open" state, only Guilds from this Zone can occupy it. When a Pass is in the "Fully Open" state, Guilds from any Zone can occupy it.
5. Players cannot teleport within a certain range around Passes.
6. During Pass battles, half of the seriously damaged units will be killed. However, when players battle against the Pass's own NPC garrisons, the units will only be seriously damaged and will not die.
7. The maximum capacity of Rally troops attacking Passes 2,000.000.
LC_COMMON_kvk_City_Gameplay_Desc_Zonebui:
"Only the unity and cooperation of the entire Zone can bring us ultimate victory."

1. There are a total of 4 Zone Command Centers in the Biozone, which are distributed across 4 different regions.
2. After an initial protection period, Zone Command Centers will remain open for contention permanently.
3. After a Zone Command Center is occupied, its Zone must complete the corresponding Missions to rebuild the Zone Command Center.
4. Rebuilding the Zone Command Center is a Mission that is divided into 3 stages. After completing each stage, all Commanders in the Zone will receive a strong buff. This buff is only effective within the Biozone.
5. After rebuilding the Zone Command Center, the Leader of the Guild that controls the Zone Command Center can choose the territory color for the Zone, and the Commanders in the same Zone can use territory teleport items to teleport their bases into any Guild Territory in that Zone.
6. After rebuilding the Zone Command Center, Glory Points will be generated continuously for the Zone.
7. During Zone Command Center battles, half of the seriously damaged units will be returned to the Garage (not applicable for battling with NPC units).
8. The maximum capacity of Rally troops attacking the Zone Command Center is 2,000,000.
LC_COMMON_kvk_City_Gameplay_Desc_Tower:
"This defensive facility plays a critical role in protecting the Pentagon, but if it falls into the wrong hands—that would be a disaster."

1. The Siege Turret will open together with the Pentagon, and they will enter the protected state.
2. Commanders cannot send troops to occupy the Siege Turret. After a Commander expels all troops that don't belong to his or her Guild from Siege Turret's range, that Commander's Guild will automatically gain control of the building.
3. If the Siege Turret is occupied by a different Guild than the one that occupies the Pentagon, the Pentagon will be attacked by the Siege Turret every 5 minutes, dealing massive damage to the Pentagon's defending troops. Seriously damaged units will be killed immediately.
LC_COMMON_kvk_City_Gameplay_Desc_Laborat:
"It appears that the biochemical weapon was developed here. We're not sure why, but it's been sealed up from the inside."

1. Bio-Labs will open once every 30 hours, and will stay open for 1 hour each time.
2. While open, waves of Bio-Lab Guards will appear. Defeat these guards to earn lots of XP and loot.
3. Commanders cannot send troops to occupy Bio-Labs. After a Commander expels all the Bio-Lab Guards and troops that don't belong to his or her Guild from a Bio-Lab's range, that Commander's Guild will automatically gain control of the building.
4. Battle will continue after a Guild gains control of a Bio-Lab. While open, Bio-Labs can change hands at any time.
5. When a member of the Guild that occupies a Bio-Lab is within range of that building, the troop's Officer will earn XP continuously, and the Commander will also earn Personal Glory Points continuously.
6. Only 1 troop can enjoy the buff effects of the Bio-Lab at a time. If a Commander has multiple troops within range, only the first troop to enter range will receive the buffs.

The Invaders were almost completely defeated on the battlefield in Europe, but they refused to give up.
After several attempts, they eventually developed a truly fearsome biological weapon.
LC_COMMON_KVK_Enter_Intro_2:
While the Allies were focused on Europe, the brutal Invaders seized the opportunity and deployed their weapons on the American mainland.

LC_COMMON_KVK_Enter_Intro_3:

It's been a tough road to make it this far—but we will be victorious in the end.

LC_COMMON_kvk_name_rule_preheat:
"The war had ended—that's what we all thought."
With the return of the Government, the war was winding down. But suddenly, a surge of terrifying, out-of-control troops appeared all over Europe, and no one knew where they had come from. Their aim was not to occupy territory, but rather to cause as much destruction as possible. Under these special circumstances, we had no choice but to put our differences aside for the moment and fight off these unexpected enemies together—and then locate their source.
 
1. The Counterattack: Origins event is divided into 3 stages, during which you can earn Personal Points and Zone Points by performing certain tasks.
2. Multiple Zones will participate in the Counterattack: Origins event, and all event rankings will include all of the participating Zones.
3. Higher-ranked Zones will receive stronger Zone Boosts as rewards, and these boosts will remain effective throughout the Biozone: Counterattack event.
4. After Counterattack: Origins ends, the route to North America will open, and Commanders from different Zones will be able to teleport into this new world of adventure.
LC_COMMON_kvk_preactivity_rule1:
Our intelligence officers hope to collect documents to locate the source of these strange enemies. The enemies in each country have mutated in a slightly different way, and the intelligence officers promise great rewards in exchange for intel on the situation in each country.

1. Defeat the Bio-Rebels that have appeared in each of the 8 countries to obtain different Bio-Rebel Letters.
2. Collect letters from all 8 countries and exchange them for an Intel Dept. Supply Chest. Open the chest for tons of rewards.
3. You will receive Personal Points and Zone Points for every exchange you perform.
4. When this stage ends, you will enter the second stage of Counterattack: Origins, and all unused event items will be reclaimed, so please use them in time.
 
 
Exchange 1 Intel Dept. Supply Chest: 4,000 Points
LC_COMMON_kvk_preactivity_rule2:
Eventually, the source of the enemies was identified: they were from North America.
In order to completely eliminate Dr. Pandora's zombie army, we need to prepare enough troops for an expedition to North America.

1. During the event, produce units to earn Personal Points and Zone Points.
2. Promote units to higher levels to earn the difference in points between the different levels.


Produce 1 Lv.1 unit: 1 Point
Produce 1 Lv.2 unit: 2 Points
Produce 1 Lv.3 unit: 4 Points
Produce 1 Lv.4 unit: 8 Points
Produce 1 Lv.5 unit: 20 Points
Produce 1 Lv.6 unit: 50 Points
LC_COMMON_kvk_preactivity_rule3:
More powerful monsters have appeared around us. If we can figure out how the these monsters work, it will certainly help us win future wars.

1. Defeat the Biochem Behemoths that appear on the map. They will drop wreckage of different Biochem Behemoth body parts.
2. Commanders can exchange the wreckage of different Biochem Behemoth body parts for different rewards.
3. You will receive Personal Points and Zone Points every time you exchange for rewards.
4. When this stage ends, the Counterattack: Origins event is completely finished. All unused event items will be reclaimed, so please use them in time.


Exchange for rewards 1 time: 1,500 Points

LC_COMMON_kvk_activity_text:
Dr. Pandora activated a time machine in an effort to turn the tide of war in her favor. Unexpectedly, the time-space continuum was disrupted, bringing multiple parallel universes together.
This disruption in spacetime created a portal that transported Pandora's Zombie Legion to America.

Pandora took the opportunity to establish a new base there: the Biozone.

1. After your HQ reaches Lv.16, you can teleport into the Biozone.
2. In the Biozone, Guilds can only build Frontline Forts, and the original Guild Forts cannot be built.
3. In the Biozone, Guilds can build Frontline Towers to expand territory, and this is the only way territory can be expanded.
4. In the Biozone, the territory tiles produce Bio Cash. Bio Cash is needed to build Frontline Towers.
5. After entering the Biozone, you can use a Targeted Teleport to return to your original server.
6. The Biozone events and Missions can only be completed while inside the Biozone.
7. No teleport items will be consumed when you teleport back to your original Zone on the final day of the Biozone event. In addition, on that day, you cannot use teleport items to teleport into the Biozone.
8.<color='#247E21'>The fires of guild buildings cannot be extinguished for 15 minutes after they start burning. If attacked while burning, the timer is reset to 15 minutes. The defenders can garrison units there to slow the burn rate (up to 50%).</color>

No matter which time or place you come from, everyone must unite to eliminate the zombies and defeat the Dead Empire all over again!
