LC_HERO_B2herostory_17: Natalia is a soldier from the icy fields of the North. She’s strong, determined and battle-hardened. In the northern wilderness she has led an independent resistance organization that excels in using the terrain to their advantage in their guerrilla raids. In addition to her combat experience she also knows how to scrounge supplies during their attacks and how to keep her fellow fighters motivated which makes her a nightmare for her enemies. Enemy intelligence has tried to find out more about Natalia but all they know is that she was born into a noble family. Why she became a heroic resistance fighter and independent leader nobody knows. Maybe ... just maybe the ring she wears around her neck hold all the answers …
LC_HERO_Slogan_Heleny: This is the road to victory!
LC_HERO_Story_07_Desc:
Natasha used to be a sniper in the special forces team "Minerva".
 Her sister, Yelena, was killed in an attack by a zombie army. Since then her only purpose in life has been avenging the death of her sister.
 After Dziewone's invitation Natasha joined S.P.E.A.R.S and began looking for revenge.
LC_HERO_Story_07_PetPhrase: Does the inertia of an object depend on the energy it contains?
LC_HERO_Story_09_PetPhrase01: What doesn't kill us only makes us stronger.
LC_HERO_Story_09_Desc: Chloe lost most of her limbs in the accident but with the help of Avalon LABS she survived. Now 70% of her body are mechanical parts. Avalon LABS was commissioned to develop a mobile armor piloted by Chloe, code name Mordred, to deal with the zombie invasion. Chloe and Mordred were then deployed with S.P.E.A.R.S as a heavy gunner.
LC_HERO_Story_12_Said: I always feel like I'm forgetting something important.
LC_HERO_Story_12_Desc:
Jeanne has no memory of her life before the age of 20. Who she is and what to live for has always been a huge question for her. That changed when she met Dziewone.
 Dziewone admired Jeanne's skills and knowledge at such young age, thinking that she was a genius.
 Dziewone invited Jeanne to join S.P.E.A.R.S. to work on a zombie vaccine.
LC_HERO_Story_12_PetPhrase: Does the inertia of an object depend on the energy it contains?
LC_HERO_Story_11_Said: "In our darkest hour can the dawn be far behind?"
LC_HERO_Story_11_Desc:
Marjorie used to be a mechanic for the special forces group Minerva. 
 The heavy casualties suffered by the Minerva team as they fought in the zombie invasion of Paris made Marjorie realize that being a mechanic alone is not enough to fight an invading army of zombies. 
 At Dziewone's invitation, Marjorie joined S.P.E.A.R.S as a heavy gunner.
LC_HERO_Story_11_PetPhrase: What good is faith if it doesn't hold when we are tested the most.
LC_HERO_Story_01_PetPhrase01: "Let us unite as one to defeat evil!"
LC_HERO_Story_01_Desc:
Katherine is a captain in the special forces group Minerva and was one of the first test subjects for project Mars, the super soldier program. 
 The Minerva team paid a heavy toll in the battle against the zombie invasion of Paris. But thanks to the S.P.E.A.R.S team's timely intervention the tragedy of Paris being completely wiped out was averted. 
 Katherine joined S.P.E.A.R.S as a commando to support the fight against the zombie armies.
LC_HERO_Story_01_PetPhrase: Let the zombies scream under my blade.
LC_HERO_Story_03_PetPhrase01: "The most merciful thing in the world is the inability of the human mind to correlate all its contents."
LC_HERO_Story_03_Desc:
Doireann used to be a mercenary until she encountered zombies during a mission. 
 Doireann survived and developed a strong interest in hunting zombies. 
 Although Dziewone is critical of Doireann's character, it is obvious that S.P.E.A.R.S needs her skills. So at Dziewone's invitation Doireann joined S.P.E.A.R.S as a Commando.
LC_HERO_Story_04_PetPhrase01: "The zombie army is just a paper tiger."
LC_HERO_Story_04_Desc:
Grace is a volunteer from China who has come to help the Allies fight the zombies. 
 In the fight against the zombie invasion of Paris, Grace joined S.P.E.A.R.S just in time to help prevent the elimination of Minerva. 
 Grace joined S.P.E.A.R.S after being invited by Dziewone.
LC_HERO_Story_04_PetPhrase: A single spark can start a prairie fire.
LC_HERO_Story_12_PetPhrase01: Science is nothing more than a refinement of everyday thinking.
LC_HERO_Story_11_PetPhrase01: The grimmer the moment, the more you gotta hang on!
LC_HERO_Story_07_PetPhrase01: When your enemies praise you, you must be doing something stupid.
LC_HERO_Story_06_Desc:
“Enough talk.” 
 
 Riven was a reservist in the British SAS special forces. 
 In Libya and all across North Africa Riven saw the horrible power of the zombie tanks of invaders. Riven's calm helped her survive the zombie tank siege. This experience made Riven realize that the war had gone beyond what anybody could have imagined. 
 Riven joined the S.P.E.A.R.S as a commando at the recommendation of David Stirling.
LC_HERO_Story_08_PetPhrase01: A man who doesn't spend time with his family can never be a real man.
LC_HERO_Story_08_Desc:
”There is no greater joy in this world than giving each other all your attention and taking care of each other.“ 
 
 Maria used to be the owner of a cafe in Sicily. Besides making good coffee, Maria is also good at chemistry. 
 One day, the residents of the town began to disappear and rumors of horrible creatures in the mountains began to spread. 
 Eventually a zombie crisis plagued the town during which Maria is saved by Captain Triglaph of the S.P.E.A.R.S. 
 Maria, who had lost her home, decided to join the S.P.E.A.R.S as a bomb specialist.
LC_HERO_Story_08_PetPhrase: Never hate your enemies. It affects your judgment.
LC_HERO_Story_10_Desc:
"The meaning of life does not lie in oneself. True happiness comes from the achievement of others." 
 
 Evelyn's older brother disappeared in Europe. His last letter was sent from Spain. 
 Evelyn went to Europe to look for her brother but got caught in a zombie attack. Fortunately, S.P.E.A.R.S rescued Evelyn and got her to safety. 
 To continue her search for her brother Evelyn joined the S.P.E.A.R.S as a Medic.
LC_HERO_Story_10_PetPhrase: No matter who taunts or attacks you, keep going!
LC_HERO_Story_10_PetPhrase01: The meaning of life does not lie in oneself. True happiness comes from the achievement of others.

Peningkatan universal Berlaku sepanjang waktu selama komandanmu tidak ditawan atau dieksekusi 
Peningkatan terbatas: Hanya berlaku di pangkalan atau di antara barisan pasukan tempat komandanmu berada saat ini.
Semua peningkatan dari Petugas dan medali akan dihitung ke dalam atribut Komandanmu.
LC_HERO_March_tips5: Kamu tidak bisa menambah komandan ketika sedang reli.
LC_HERO_March_tips6: Komandan tidak bisa memperkuat pangkalan pemain lain.
LC_HERO_March_tips7: Kamu tidak bisa menambahkan komandan lain jika Pemerintah telah memilikinya.
LC_HERO_March_scout_tips2: Komandan Musuh tidak berada di pangkalan.
LC_HERO_Commander_map_details1: Kalahkan penangkap untuk membebaskan semua komandan di penjara.
LC_HERO_Officer_tips1: Pemberitahuan: kumpulkan material rekrutmen untuk merekrut petugas yang akan bertarung untukmu.
LC_HERO_Officer_tips2: Pemberitahuan: saat petugas berperang, dia akan memberi bonus tambahan untuk komandannya.
LC_HERO_Officer_material_info:
The following activities help you get chances to acquire recruitment materials:
1. Purchase material box from Store
2. Complete Guild Mission, Solo Mission and Daily Mission
3. Complete Guild Event, Solo Event, Glory Event
4. Defeat the rebels
LC_HERO_Officer_NoOfficer: Kamu tidak punya petugas jenis ini, silahkan kunjungi Sekolah Militer dan melakukan perekrutan.
LC_HERO_Officer_info: Saat petugas berperang, dia akan memberi bonus tambahan untuk komandannya. Petugas tidak bisa diperintah apabila levelnya melebihi level Komandan. Petugas bisa dipromosikan dengan material. Setelah promosi, atribut petugas akan bertambah. Petugas dibedakan dalam 6 kualitas:
LC_HERO_Officer_Slot2_D: Modifikasi, temuan, mereka adalah ahli bidang mesin.
LC_HERO_Officer_Slot3_D: Pejuang yang haus darah, selalu berada di barisan terdepan.
LC_HERO_Officer_FullM: Unit telah mencapai batas pengangkutan material, tidak bisa mengangkut lebih banyak lagi. Mohon tarik Unit dengan tepat waktu.
LC_HERO_Officer_MaxLevel: Telah dipromosikan ke rank lebih tinggi
LC_HERO_Officer_MaterialRule_D:
1. Persediaan dan material yang didapat dari pertarungan akan diangkut ke kota oleh Unit.
2. Setiap unit dapat mengangkut persediaan sesuai dengan muatan unit tersebut.
3. Setiap unit dapat mengangkut maksimal 50 material. Unit tidak bisa mengangkut lagi apabila melebihi kapasitas.
LC_HERO_Officer_RankTips: Pemberitahuan: setiap petugas memiliki 5 rank. Tingkatkan Atribut petugas dengan mempromosikannya ke rank lebih tinggi.
LC_HERO_Medal_List_tips: Tips: sekolah Militer dapat mempromosikan medali tingkat rendah ke tingkat yang lebih tinggi
LC_HERO_Officer_RF3_D: Mempromosikan 2 medali tingkat rendah untuk 1 medali tingkat yang lebih tinggi
LC_HERO_Medal_tips1: Silakan pilih medali yang Anda ingin mempromosikan
LC_HERO_Medal_tips3: Tips: 2 medali yang sama dapat mempromosikan ke 1 sama tetapi lebih tinggi medali tingkat
LC_HERO_Medal_tips4: Tips: Anda tidak bisa melihat medali yang telah equit ke petugas.
LC_HERO_March_tips8: Tidak ada komandan dapat memasuki gedung Pasukan ketika sudah ada satu di dalam.

LC_HERO_Story_02_Desc:
"Keep your friends close, but your enemies closer."

Angelica is an intelligence officer in the Rouge Ravens.
Disguised as a researcher, she successfully infiltrated Medusa in order to learn about Dr. Pandora's evil plans.
However, Dr. Pandora is naturally suspicious and unwilling to extend trust easily, so Angelica was unable to learn the full picture of his plans.
Angelica escaped from Medusa just in time, before her true identity was revealed.
LC_HERO_Story_05_Desc:
"The eagle's eyes, the wolf's ears, the bear's strength!"

Jessica worked as a cryptologist in the Minerva special forces.
High Command suspected that the Invaders' deciphering of communications had led to Minerva's defeat in Paris.
To enhance the security of all communications, Minerva recruited Jessica to design new encryption measures.
Not only is Jessica proficient in many forms of cryptography, she also has a special ability to communicate with animals.
LC_HERO_Story_14_Desc:
"Don't be sorry—be better."

Lilith is a commando in the Minerva special forces.
She thinks she should have been chosen as Captain—not Katherine.
Lilith belonged to the second cohort of subjects in Project Mars—a super-soldier program—and data shows that she gained more strength, reflexes, and speed than Katherine did.
Lilith hopes she can make up for the humiliation of Minerva's defeat in Paris.
LC_HERO_Story_13_Desc:
"The loving one will forgive your sins, and it is my mission to deliver you to her."

Angel was an orphan.
Sister Isabel took care her at the convent, but then Medusa Invaders killed Sister Isabel.
In her grief, Angel took up Sister Isabel's nun outfit, hoping to bring light to this apocalyptic world, just like Sister Isabel.
Dziewone found Angel and invited her to join S.P.E.A.R.S. as a medic.
LC_HERO_Story_15_Desc:
"When you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss also gazes into you."

Loubna is an intelligence officer in the Rouge Ravens.
She disguises herself as a dancer, gathering information as she dances in bars in Casablanca.
She learned that the Python Virus gives its users extraordinary strength, reflexes, and speed, and the zombie transformation is actually a side effect. Not all users will turn into zombies.
LC_HERO_Story_16_Desc:
"No one can withstand my power!"

Helena was originally an Officer assigned to Medusa.
When Dr. Pandora asked Helena to use the Python Virus, she refused, and then she was attacked by the Medusa Invaders.
Helena discovered that it was the Python Virus that was turning people into zombies. Disgusted with What Dr. Pandora had done, Helena decided to destroy her and her evil plans.
LC_HERO_Story_17_Desc:
"To accomplish a something great, one must start small."

Natalia was one of the first members of S.P.E.A.R.S.
Natalia, Dziewone, and Triglaph fought the Zombie Legion for the first time after the Invaders infiltrated Spain, but they greatly underestimated its fighting power. The battle ended in a disastrous defeat—Dziewone lost his left eye, Triglaph went missing, and most of their troops were killed.
Having survived, Natalia hates her own weaknesses. She trains herself constantly, hoping to be able to avenge them all one day.

LC_HERO_Story_18_Desc:
"Blood makes us human, more than human, and human no more."

About 100 years ago, Dorothea and Carmilla disagreed over whether to summon their Lord. In the end, Dorothea chose to enter a long slumber.
Pandora's Zombie Legion awakened Dorothea when they invaded Spain.
Dorothea is disgusted by Pandora's actions and believes that has desecrated their blood.
In order to cleanse Pandora's desecration, Dorothea—the last vampire—decides to temporarily join forces with the Allies to destroy the Zombie Legion.
LC_HERO_Story_19_Desc:
"Zombies, monsters, whatever—I will eradicate them all!"

Ophelia is the eldest of the Raptor Sisters and a member of the special forces team "Minerva".
The Raptor Sisters became famous throughout the Americas for their ability to hunt and kill monsters. Ophelia is called "Silver Eagle" because she has silver hair and is always accompanied by her eagle.
After hearing about the emergence of zombies in Europe, Ophelia and her two younger sisters came to Europe to hunt them down.
LC_HERO_Story_20_Desc:
"Have you seen a vampire with green eyes?"

Abigail is the second sister of the Raptor Sisters and a member of the special forces team "Minerva".
The three sisters' father was a monster hunter who was killed by a vampire with green eyes while on a hunting mission.
Abigail vowed to find the vampire who killed her father and avenge his death.
LC_HERO_Story_21_Desc:
"If you can give me a plane, I'll give you my luck!"

Diana always dreamed of becoming a pilot. Her dream never came true, but she dressed as a pilot anyway.
Despite her unfulfilled dream, Diana possessed the amazing fortune to be able to traverse the battlefield unscathed.
Intrigued by Diana's good fortune, Dziewone invited her to join S.P.E.A.R.S. as a scout.
LC_HERO_Story_22_Desc:
"Let's see what's faster: your blink, or my gun."

Monica is the youngest of the Raptor Sisters and a member of the special forces team "Minerva".
Monica is known for her fast guns, which can hit a coin thrown into the air in 0.2 seconds.
She might look sweet, but Monica is fierce in battle. Her specially designed silver bullets are effective at killing monsters, and Monica takes great pleasure in that.
LC_HERO_Story_25_Desc:
"The Tao produced One; One produced Two; Two produced Three; Three produced All Things."

Wang Tuantuan, also known as Sirius, is an elite warrior from Penglai Mountain.
An ancient prophecy from Penglai Mountain predicted that zombies would bring on the apocalypse, so their elite warriors have long trained to face this crisis.
According to the prophecy, only by locating the Golden Elixir can the world be saved.
By the order of the Hierarch, Wang Tuantuan has come to Europe to locate the elixir.
LC_HERO_Story_90_Desc:
"Behind every great man stands a great woman."

Amanda is a samba dancer from Brazil.
Her father is a biomedical scientist who mysteriously disappeared when Pandora and her Zombie Legion came to America.
Amanda suspects that the Medusa Invaders captured her father.
In order to find him, Amanda picks up a grenade launcher and heads to North America's Biozone.
LC_HERO_Story_91_Desc:
"The home does not rest upon the ground, but upon a woman's shoulders."

Anna is a monster hunter from Mexico, but she's also known as Viking Dahlia because of her colorful clothing and her agility.
Monica, one of the three Raptor Sisters, once killed a monster that Anna had been hunting, and then mocked her for it. Now Anna hates the Raptor Sisters—especially Monica.
As Pandora and her Zombie Legion arrive in America, Anna picks up her three-barreled pistol and heads straight for that army of zombies.
LC_HERO_Story_92_Desc:
"All things in the world come from being, and being comes from non-being."

Wang Yuanyuan, also known as Polaris, is an elite warrior from Penglai Mountain.
Wang Yuanyuan and Wang Tuantuan are twin sisters. They are the most powerful warriors in Penglai Mountain, and together, they're unstoppable.
There had been no news from Alkaid, who had gone to Europe to find the Golden Elixir. That substance seemed to be known as the "Philosopher's Stone" in Europe.
In order to find the Golden Elixir and Alkaid, Wang Yuanyuan has been ordered to go to the European battlefront.
LC_HERO_Story_26_Desc:
"When the sakura blossoms bloom, that's the time to blow the horn for a counterattack!"

A descendant of the samurai, Sakura—full name Sakura Takeda—was perhaps influenced by her father: while other girls were chasing after the latest trendy fashions, Sakura was obsessed with history and strategy.
Her family education included not only traditional etiquette, but also combat skills. The Takeda clan seemed to be ready for war at any moment.
While Sakura was studying in Europe, Pandora's Zombie Legion blockaded the continent, trapping her there. Dziewone then invited her to join S.P.E.A.R.S.
LC_HERO_Skill_Attribute_Name_22_64: Enemy Wounded to Seriously Wounded Increase
LC_HERO_Story_27_Desc:
"I'm no doctor. Just call me Lady."

Medusa's army continues to lose ground as allied forces grow stronger. Unwilling to admit defeat, Dr. Pandora activated a time machine to try to change the tides of war. Instead, she created a rift in the space-time fabric.

From the rift emerged another self from a parallel universe, a scientist from the Grenoble Bio Labs–Lady Pandora.

This kind-hearted scientist cannot accept what her "self" is doing in this universe and decided to join the allied forces to stop Dr. Pandora's evil plan.
LC_HERO_Story_28_Desc:
"Freedom always comes at a price. That price depends on your choices."

Olivia is a member of the Norwegian Frost Resistance. Her twin is the head of the organization, and the two sisters are known throughout Norway as battle heroes.

But during a particularly dangerous mission, Olivia fell into the Invaders' trap and was captured and held in a secret lab.

Just one day before she was to be viral-modified, she mysteriously disappeared from the lab, never to be heard of again.

Still, people continue to claim that the special arrows used by Olivia are found on zombie corpses...
LC_HERO_Story_29_Desc:
“I believe in fate. I also believe my fate is in my hands."

Sophia is the head of the Norwegian Frost Resistance. Her twin sister is also a member of the organization.

When her sister disappeared during a mission, Sophia felt desperate and hopeless. Her group's morale fell to an all-time low.

But after a secret rescue mission, things started to look up. Battling Invaders became easier, as if someone was helping them behind the scenes.

Though Sophia hasn't said anything on the matter, her teammates regained much confidence in their fight against the Invaders.
LC_HERO_Story_30_Desc:
"People betray, machines don't"
 
Christina's father is a logistics engineer at S.P.E.A.R.S. Her father taught her to repair machines during her youth and she showed amazing talent for it.
Dziewone soon took note of this gifted girl and invited her to join S.P.E.A.R.S.
The only problem is, Christina seems to prefer fiddling with robots rather than killing enemies in battle...
LC_HERO_Story_31_Desc:
"Aim! Dodge! Fire!"
 
Hannah's dream is to become a great sailor and sail around the world on a huge cruise ship. However, the zombies' appearance shattered her dream.
So, Hannah answered the call to arms and joined {0}'s fleet as part of the alliance against Dr. Pandora.
Hannah was soon made captain of USS Fletcher owing to her excellent sailing skills and leadership ability.

LC_HERO_Story_60_Desc:
"Desert, heed my call and blot out the sun!"
 
 Pharah, a veteran commander of the Thunder Corps, lost contact with her squad amidst the chaos brought by the impending doomsday.
 She was the sole survivor. As she roamed the land she came upon a leaderless tank battalion. With these under her command, she became known as the Queen of Sahara in Africa.
 Sahara's ruler has left the desert and is searching for her long-lost war companions.
LC_HERO_Story_33_Desc:
"To protect the forest, uphold justice, and defend life."
 
Ida hails from a family of verderers protecting the Forest of Dean. Following her training, she and her hound patrolled the forest. One day they saw monsters of the Apocalypse destroy a village.
From that day, Ida embarked upon a journey to slay any and all Apocalypse monsters.
LC_HERO_Story_34_Desc:
"If you can't help prevent the Apocalypse, at least tell the world about it."
 
Aurora dreamt of becoming a war reporter ever since she worked as a trainee at the local newspaper. She survived the Apocalypse's arrival as she was undergoing safety training in the United Kingdom at the time.
Having experienced the Apocalypse, she has what it takes to pursue her dream career.
LC_HERO_Story_36_Desc:
"Power is justice and leads to freedom."
 
 Su'an, the one known as the Princess of War, was famed for her military talent and knowledge. She would use any strategy at her disposal to get the upper hand and weaken her foe.
 But rather than commanding from the backlines, Su'an much preferred to lead her forces into battle herself, to destroy her enemies with her own two hands.

LC_Hero_Equip_Dismantle_Tips_2: 100% of Crafting Materials will be returned when disassembling Equipment below Legendary.
LC_Hero_Equip_Dismantle_Tips_3: Equipment Blueprints and Energy spent in crafting won't be returned.

LC_Hero_Equip_Material_Composite_Error: Legendary Materials cannot be further synthesized.
LC_Hero_Equip_Material_Dismantle_Error: Rare Materials cannot be further disassembled.
LC_HERO_Story_35_Desc:
"Shoot them an RPG and there will be no problem. If that's not enough, shoot another one."
 
 The Cerberus Legion of the Invader was bombed a few times and suffered a great loss when they drew near the French frontier, and had to change their plan and choose another path.
 
 "I saw her...but didn't see her face. She was like a ghost, not leaving any trace," said a survivor from the Legion.
LC_Hero_Equip_Wore_Dismantle_Hint: Equipment is equipped on Officer {0}. Disassemble now?
LC_Hero_Equip_Wear_Error: Officer must be in base to perform this action.
LC_Hero_Equip_Material_Composite_Error_1: Rare materials cannot be acquired via synthesis.
LC_Hero_Equip_Material_Dismantle_Error_1: Legendary materials cannot be acquired by disassembling.
LC_HERO_Story_37_Desc:
"Don't give up. The darkness will falter."
 
 The Scandinavian Peninsula was thrown into chaos when the enemy invaded and the virus broke out.
 Erin is like a ray of light amid the endless darkness. No matter how dire the situation is, she will encourage any survivor to persevere.
 And in the end, it was this 16-year-old girl who emerged from within the darkness with the other survivors in tow.
LC_HERO_Story_38_Desc:
"Everyone has their own destiny."
 
 Hardwin is an actress who has achieved great success due to her outstanding acting in gang films.
 Yet, some say that she is affiliated with them not only on the screen but in the real world too.
 While she's never responded to these accusations, her ability amid total chaos seems to prove them true.
 Those who now follow her have taken to calling her the Godmother.
LC_HERO_Story_39_Desc:
"War does not make us stronger. The only one with the power to do that is ourselves."

Derya joined a local squadron and fought against the zombie legion. Strong and agile, she excels at using heavy machine guns. Yet, her strong appearance belies her soft heart. She came upon a stray cat during one of her missions. Unable to leave the defenseless little creature be, she brought it back and raised it. The cat soon became her faithful companion.
Once during a vital mission, the zombies kept coming, and they showed no signs of stopping. The morale of Derya and her squad drained away as the endless tide continued no matter how many they felled. That was until her tiny cat threw itself at one of the beasts. This ignited a spark within Derya. She rallied her allies, and they fought with renewed vigor, ultimately vanquishing the zombie horde. Derya and her companions became the heroes of that battle.
LC_HERO_Story_40_Desc:
"Lies are my weapons, victory is my sole objective."

Eunice is an enigma, to say the least. While appearing before others as a popular illusionist, in reality, she is an exceptional agent who has undergone rigorous training.
She was once tasked with infiltrating the HQ of a secret organization and thwarting their wicked plans. Having made her way inside and acquired important intel, she triggered the alarm on her way out. Enemies surged at her in droves upon droves. They were met by a bright light and thick smoke, whereupon Eunice was nowhere to be seen. She had vanished into thin air. All that remained was a card—the Ace of Hearts.

Spend {0} x{1} to unlock {2}
 and switch to this blank talent page?
LC_HERO_Story_41_Desc:
"Wherever my blade points, evil falls!"
 
The Matsumoto family was all but slaughtered during a rebellion, with the little girl Yuki being the sole survivor.
 
She left her home on a journey to hone her skills. She threw away her samurai pride and learned both ninjutsu and marksmanship. She'd do anything to exact revenge.
 
Having left home, she learned that disaster had struck the world. Her revenge seemed insignificant compared to all the hardships out there. And so she clasped tight her weapon and embarked upon a journey of redemption...
LC_HERO_Story_42_Desc:
"Lilies bloom, and hope with them."
 
Liliana is the princess of Belgium. Atypical for a little girl, she underwent rigorous military training from a young age. She joined her first battle full of confidence when she was 19, after which she won countless victories. She was recognized as the youngest and one of the most brilliant commanders in light of her achievements.
 
She yearned for victory and would never tolerate defeat. She believed that by achieving one victory after another, she could bring hope to her subjects.
LC_HERO_Story_43_Desc:
"There's no problem that the right potion can't solve."

Born in the City of Prosperity, Chicago, in the Midwest of the United States, Jane showed a strong interest in science and chemistry from a young age. The young Jane always liked to experiment with various chemicals in her small home laboratory, accumulating a wealth of knowledge and experience. With her intelligence and relentless efforts, she eventually became a skilled apothecary, mastering various powerful potion skills. At the same time, she used these skills to face various challenges in life.
LC_HERO_Story_44_Desc:
"Find the melody within your heart."

Meet Melina, a vibrant Chilean musician. No matter when or where, she showcases her talent and passion with her beloved electric guitar, captivating countless people. Despite facing various difficulties and challenges, she has never given up. For her, music is not only her sanctuary but also her source of strength. Regardless of how the environment changes, she firmly believes that the power of music is eternal, capable of inspiring endless courage and hope.
LC_HERO_Story_45_Desc:
"Only the most perceptive can survive, be it in fashion or on the battlefield."

Julia is a striking figure. Her cool demeanor and sharp intuition set her apart, making her a beacon of inspiration. She is renowned for her stunning appearances and unique sense of fashion, drawing attention wherever she goes. Yet, beneath her glamorous exterior lies a ruthless warrior.
LC_HERO_Story_46_Desc:
"Every challenge is an opportunity to become stronger. Are you ready to accept this gift?"

Miyeon is from Seoul, Korea, and her leadership and charm are unmatched. Her smile is sweet and warm, shining on her comrades like the sun, giving them hope in the toughest moments. Her beauty and strength coexist, and her every appearance can boost the team's morale.
LC_HERO_Story_47_Desc:
"Dance with me, like the stars under the moonlight."

Her courage and determination make her unflinching in the face of every challenge. Her grace and charm are like an unfinished dance. She is both the elegant ballet that inspires allies with steadfast resolve and the storm of strength that unleashes endless energy to destroy enemies. Every move she makes is a testament to her unwavering determination and boundless energy. This is Betty, agile and powerful, small yet shining like stardust.
LC_HERO_Story_48_Desc:
"Gain strength in silence. Search for your target in solitude."

Camille always stands alone, outside the crowd, her gaze deep and unique, as if she can see through every soul among the people. But she is not isolated; she chooses solitude, a path only she can understand. Beneath her composed exterior lies a burning passion for justice. She is a patient observer, a resolute actor, striking when the time is right.

LC_HERO_Story_49_Desc:
"In this boundless blue, each breath brings me closer to the truth."

Hailing from the north, this brave soul grew up alongside the sea, as comfortable in the underwater world as she is on land. Proficient in the use of various equipment, she navigates the deep sea with ease, whether it's searching for lost treasures or studying rare creatures. Her skills not only enable her to work underwater for extended periods but also allow her to respond swiftly in times of crisis. In the depths of the ocean, she always finds ways to coexist harmoniously with the environment, protecting the azure realm she dearly loves.
LC_HERO_Story_50_Desc:
"In this endless chaos, I choose to be the master of my own fate."

On the happiest day of her life, she donned a white gown, never anticipating the cruel trials fate had in store for her. The chainsaw in her hand is not for show, but a sharp weapon against the chaotic world. Each graceful turn is for survival, and every glance she casts is captivating and soul-stirring. On the edge of love and fear, she crafted a unique ritual in her own way. Her existence proves that even in despair, one can find a fusion of strength and beauty.

LC_HERO_Story_51_Desc:
"Even if darkness envelops us, the flame in our hearts will continue to burn, never to be extinguished."

"Black Angel," this name is whispered like a ghostly wisp within the Black Prison. It is said that her story is filled with hardships and trials, but her will is more resolute than the darkness and freer than the prisoners. Her figure shines brightly in the Black Prison, like an undying star, illuminating the hearts of the inmates.

In that terrifying environment, she learned to find hope in despair, to seek life in adversity, and to face various challenges with unwavering faith and indomitable will. The scars and chains she bears have become symbols of her relentless struggle, inspiring awe and respect in all who hear of her.
LC_HERO_Story_52_Desc:
"I love the song of the nightingale, even though they only sing in the dead of night."

The unparalleled beauty of Shanghai, born into a scholarly family, but due to the decline of her family, she was forced to become an intelligence broker to make a living. She dances gracefully like a nightingale, with hidden secrets behind her fluttering fan; at social dances, she is elegant and captivating, gathering intelligence with ease. Sharing a glass of red wine with her, secrets are concealed within the cup. She can become invisible in the bustling night, understanding the myriad of worldly affairs. Despite her tumultuous fate, being caught in the battle for intelligence and becoming a prisoner, she remains unparalleled in beauty, viewing the prison as a new stage, always longing to return to the prosperous era.

LC_MAIL_b2_content_hq_level_info_lv2:
Now, you can build the APC Armory and Steel Mill. 
The APC Armory can produce APCs, which will provide great flexibility in battle. The Steel Mill can produce Steel, which is a necessary resource to develop your base!
LC_MAIL_b2_content_hq_level_info_lv3:
Now, you can build Anti-tank Gun Armory and Monument.
Anti-tank Gun Armory can produce Anti-tank Gun units, they can deal lots of damage to tanks, but weak of APCs.
In Monument you can check the biggest events of the world, and get rewards of them.
LC_MAIL_b2_content_hq_level_info_lv4:
Now, you can build the Lab and Oil Rig. 
Researching various technologies in the Lab can both develop your base and strengthen your battle strength. The Oil Rig can produce Oil, which is widely used in future development.
LC_MAIL_b2_content_hq_level_info_lv5:
Now, you can build the Rocket Launcher Armory and Store. 
The Rocket Launcher Armory can produce Rocket Launchers, which is adept at gathering resources. The Store is where you can purchase resources or speedup items to accelerate your base development.
LC_MAIL_b2_content_hq_level_info_lv6:
Now, you can build the Railway Station. 
Trains will stop here and sell goods at lower prices.
LC_MAIL_b2_content_hq_level_info_lv7:
Now, you can build the Hall of War. 
Here you can form a more powerful army with your Guild members to rally attack your enemies.
LC_MAIL_b2_content_hq_level_info_lv8: Important Info: level 8 Lab can research and unlock Tier-2 troops.
LC_MAIL_b2_content_hq_level_info_lv9: You can build another Farm and Garage.
LC_MAIL_b2_content_hq_level_info_lv10:
Now, you can build the Power Plant. 
The Power Plant will produce Energy, which is a necessary resource for base construction and unit production.

LC_MAIL_b2_text_guild_leader_transfer:
Your Guild Leader position will be automatically transferred in {0} hour(s) because the Guild Leader hasn't logged into the game for a long time.
Transfer Rules:
1. Active players with no more than {0} hours offline time are more likely to be selected as the new Guild Leader.
2. Players at the highest Ranks are more likely to be selected as the new Guild Leader (R4>R3>R2>R1).
3. Players who are in the highest Rank and have the highest Power are more likely to be selected as the new Guild Leader.
4. If your Guild Leader logs into the game in {0} hour(s), then the transfer will be canceled.
5. A new Guild Leader will be selected once the transfer is complete, and all Guild Members will receive a Leader Transfer Notice.

Mulai saat ini, setiap level markas Anda naik, kami akan menawarkan lebih banyak konten game kepada Anda, jadi perhatikanlah baik-baik! 

Seperti yang Anda tahu, di dunia ini ada begitu banyak pasukan, dengan ukuran yang beragam, dari yang sangat besar hingga sangat kecil. Bergabung dalam suatu pasukan adalah cara terbaik untuk meningkatkan kekuatan pribadi Anda.

Ketuk pada tombol aktifkan Pasukan di bawah dan masuki halaman utama Pasukan untuk mulai mencari sekutu, saling membantu untuk berkembang lebih cepat, dan berbagi kegembiraan dengan teman-teman Anda. 

Anda tidak akan sendirian dalam pertempuran!

Due to your long period of inactivity, you have been removed from the Guild by the system.

This general management measure is intended to optimize the Guild member structure and ensure there are enough spots for all active members, maintaining the healthy development and vibrant atmosphere of the Guild. LC_MAP_AllianceBuilding_BasicTips:
Guild Forts are the starting point for Guild Territory.

1. A Guild Fort can protect territory within a 15x15 tile square around it. Empty tiles within this area can still be occupied by another Guild.
2. Territory tiles are valid only when they are linked with a Guild Fort.
3. When a member is gathering within the Guild Territory, their Gathering Speed will increase by 25%.
4. Only members can teleport their bases within the Guild Territory.
5. For battles in a Guild Fort or Tower, half of the defender's seriously wounded units will be sent to their Garage, while all the attacker's seriously wounded units will die.
LC_MAP_AllianceBuilding_DurabilityTips:

2. When Durability is decreased to 0, the building will be destroyed. The Guild has to rebuild it.

LC_MAP_City_Buff_Desc:
When a City is occupied, it will provide Lv.1 City Boosts for all Guild members.
When 20% of the City’s territory is occupied, it will provide Lv.2 City Boosts.
When 50% of the City’s territory is occupied, it will provide Lv.3 City Boosts.
LC_MAP_City_Gameplay_Desc_Lv1:
"I don't know where he's from, but I know he died as a hero!"

1. As Zone News progresses, Lv.1 Cities will open first.
2. When Lv.1 Cities open, they will be available for contention every 3 days. During that period, all Guilds can attack a City, and a Guild that occupies a City for 4 hours will claim its dominion.
3. The first Commander (Rally initiator) that occupies a City will lead troops in the City to defend against other Guilds. When this player leaves, the most powerful player remaining will automatically become the new leader to defend the City.
4. Boost effects from Cities of the same type can't be stacked.
5. All seriously wounded units will be sent to the Garage when battling in Lv.1 Cities.
6. The maximum capacity of Rally troops attacking Lv.1 Cities is 1,500,000.
LC_MAP_City_Gameplay_Desc_Lv2:
“Only those are fit to live who are not afraid to die!"

1. As Zone News progresses, Lv.2 Cities will open after Lv.1 Cities.
2. When Lv.2 Cities open, they will be available for contention every 3 days. During that period, all Guilds can attack a City, and a Guild that occupies a City for 4 hours will claim its dominion.
3. The first Commander (Rally initiator) that occupies a City will lead troops in the City to defend against other Guilds. When this player leaves, the most powerful player remaining will automatically become the new leader to defend the City.
4. Boost effects from Cities of the same type can’t be stacked.
5. Half of the seriously wounded units will be sent to the Garage when battling in Lv.2 Cities.
6. The maximum capacity of Rally troops attacking Lv.2 Cities is 1,500,000.
LC_MAP_City_Gameplay_Desc_Lv3:
“Casualties: Countless!” “Casualty Rate: I don't know!” “Outcome: We will win!”

1. As Zone News progresses, Lv.3 Cities will open after Lv.2 Cities.
2. When Lv.3 Cities open, they will be available for contention every 3 days. During that period, all Guilds can attack against a City, and a Guild that occupies a City for 4 hours will claim its dominion.
3. The first Commander (Rally initiator) that occupies a City will lead troops in the City to defend against other Guilds. When this player leaves, the most powerful player remaining will automatically become the new leader to defend the City.
4. Boost effects from Cities of the same type can’t be stacked.
5. Half of the seriously wounded units will be sent to the Garage when battling in Lv.3 Cities.
6. The maximum capacity of Rally troops attacking Lv.3 Cities is 1,500,000.

LC_MAP_Map_TileDesc_Farm:
A Crop Field provides us Food.

1. All commanders can send units to Resource Points (Crop Field, Steel Plant, Oil Refinery, Power Plant) to gather resources.
2. The higher level a Resource Point, the more resources it has.
3. When a member is gathering within the Guild Territory, their Gathering Speed will increase by 25%.
4. After completing gathering, your units will automatically transport resources back to your base.
5. You can deploy units to attack a Resource Point when another player is gathering. The winner gets the right to gather from this Resource Point.

LC_MAP_Map_TileDesc_River:
Your troops can get through Narrow Rivers.
You can occupy Narrow Rivers as your Guild Territory.

1. Commanders in a Guild can occupy tiles.
2. The tiles you occupy must be linked with existing Guild Territory titles.
3. Territory tiles are valid only when they are linked with a Guild Fort.
4. When a member is gathering within the Guild Territory, their Gathering Speed will increase by 25%.
5. Only members can teleport their bases within the Guild Territory.
6. When attacking another Guild's Buildings or Cities, their Territory must be linked with your Guild's first.

LC_MAP_Map_TileDesc_GuildTower:
Guild Towers protect your Guild Territory.

1. A Guild Tower must be built on a 3x3 tile square within the Guild Territory.
2. A Guild Tower can protect territory within a 15x15 tile square around it. Empty tiles within this area can still be occupied by another Guild.
3. When a member is gathering within the Guild Territory, their Gathering Speed will increase by 25%.
4 Only members can teleport their bases within the Guild Territory.
5. For battles in a Guild Fort or Tower, half of the defender's seriously wounded units will be sent to their Garage, while all the attacker's seriously wounded units will die.
LC_MAP_City_Gameplay_Desc_Governor:
"Now this is not the end. It is not even the beginning of the end. But it is, perhaps, the end of the beginning."

1. As Zone News progresses, the Government will finally open.
2. When the Government opens, it will be available for contention every 7 days. During that period, all Guilds can attack the Government, and a Guild that occupies the Government for 8 hours will claim its dominion.
3. The first Commander (Rally initiator) that occupies the Government will lead troops in the Government to defend against other Guilds. When this player leaves, the most powerful player remaining will automatically become the new leader to defend the Government.
4. All seriously wounded units will die when battling in the Government (not applied for battles with NPC units).
5. The maximum capacity of Rally troops attacking the Government is 1,500,000.

LC_MAP_Map_TileDesc_GuildSupplyDepot:
The guild supply depot is an important resource building for the guild.
 
 1. The guild supply depot needs to be built on 3x3 area in the guild’s territory.
 2. Resources at the guild supply depot can be collected by all members of the guild.
 3. As a shared resource building the guild supply depot cannot be attacked during the construction and resource collection process.
 4. When the resources in the guild supply depot reach 0 the supply depot will disappear.
 5. If not completed within the specified time during the construction the guild supply depot will disappear.
 6. When the construction of the guild supply depot is completed, a countdown will begin after which the guild supply depot will disappear.
 7. The guild can only have one supply depot at a time and only when the current supply depot disappears can it build the next guild supply depot.
 8. The guild supply depot cannot be cancelled after construction has begun.

LC_MAP_HTP_Welcome: Selamat datang di Peta Zona! Kamu bisa melakukan banyak hal di sini:
LC_MAP_HTP_Lesson1_D:
*Kamu bisa melihat banyak petak persediaan di peta. Petak persediaan menyediakan persediaan yang dibutuhkan pangkalanmu. 

*Klik petak dan pilih "Kumpulkan", lalu kirim unitmu ke petak tersebut. Setelah selesai mengumpulkan, mereka akan langsung kembali ke pangkalanmu.
LC_MAP_HTP_Lesson2_D:
*Ingin tau informasi unit dan persediaan pemain lain? Klik pangkalan pemain yang diinginkan dan pilih "Intai" untuk mengintai. Semakin tinggi level pengintaianmu, semakin banyak informasi yang didapatkan. Periksa kotak surat untuk melihat laporan pengintaian. 

*Perhatian: Targetmu akan mengetahui bahwa kamu sedang mengintainya. Dia tidak akan senang jika diintai.
LC_MAP_HTP_Lesson3_D:
*Ini adalah permainan perang. Tentu saja kamu bisa menyerang pemain lainnya. Klik pangkalan milik pemain lain dan pilih "Serang" untuk mengirim unitmu agar menyerang pemain tersebut.

*Setelah menyerang, kamu bisa melihat Laporan Pertarungan dan Putar Video di kotak suratmu.
LC_MAP_HTP_Lesson4_D:
*Kamu bisa menduduki wilayah dalam permainan. Bergabunglah dengan pasukan terlebih dahulu, pilih petak non-persediaan di samping pangkalan dan pilih "Tempati", unitmu akan menduduki petak ini untuk pasukan.

*Kamu bisa mengumpulkan lebih cepat dan mendapat ekstra persediaan untuk Bank Pasukan melalui Wilayah. Wilayahmu melambangkan kemajuanmu.
LC_MAP_MiniMap_D:
*Kamu bisa mengganti rentang tampilan untuk memeriksa wilayah pasukan lain. Tampilan maksimal adalah 50 Pasukan Teratas.

*Pada rentang tertentu, hanya akan ditampilkan pasukan yang memiliki paling sedikit 5 wilayah.

LC_OTHER_Challenge_Scenario_story_1: Pada tahun 1942, di medan perang Afrika Utara dalam PD2, pasukan Sekutu bertempur di Tunisia untuk menghancurkan pasukan Axis. Pasukan Axis bertahan sementara waktu, namun berkat pasokan yang memadai, Sekutu mulai mendapatkan keuntungan dalam serangan. Pada bulan Maret 1943, pasukan Sekutu melancarkan serangan umum dan mengalahkan pasukan Axis Afrika.
LC_OTHER_Challenge_Scenario_story_2: Pada tahun 1944, di medan perang Perang Dunia II di Eropa, pasukan Sekutu menyerang Jerman di Front Timur dan Front Barat. Untuk menghancurkan musuh di Barat, Jerman melancarkan serangan mendadak di Ardennes dalam cuaca buruk. Setelah kondisi cuaca membaik, pasukan sekutu yang telah berkumpul melakukan serangan balik dan mengalahkan Jerman.
LC_OTHER_Challenge_Scenario_story_3: Pada tahun 1942, di medan perang Afrika Utara dalam PD2, pasukan Axis meluncurkan serangan untuk menguasai pelabuhan Aleksandria. Namun, karena perlawanan sengit, pertempuran berakhir dengan jalan buntu. Pada bulan Oktober, karena tak ada kemajuan, pasukan Persemakmuran pura-pura melakukan serangan, kemudian mengirim pasukan elite dan mengalahkan pasukan Axis.
LC_OTHER_Challenge_Scenario_story_4: Pada tahun 1940, di medan perang Tiongkok dalam PD2, serangan ditujukan untuk menembus pemblokiran tentara Jepang. Pada bulan September, pasukan Tiongkok mengerahkan 105 resimen ke medan perang. Pada bulan Oktober, Jepang membalas dengan mengirim bala bantuan, dan pasukan Tiongkok kemudian mengubahnya menjadi perang gerilya. Serangan berlangsung hingga Januari 1941.
LC_OTHER_Challenge_Scenario_how_to_play:
1. Pemain harus menggunakan Kupon Tantangan untuk naik di setiap level. Setelah mencapai kemenangan 3-Bintang, pemain dapat mempercepat level ini.
2. Mempercepat satu kali akan menggunakan jumlah Kupon Tantangan yang sama dengan tantangan level.
3. Kemenangan 3-Bintang dan Mempercepat akan memberikan kesempatan pada pemain untuk mendapatkan imbalan level.
4. Kekalahan pertempuran yang ditampilkan dalam tantangan adalah kekalahan pertempuran virtual yang tidak akan menyebabkan kekalahan nyata untuk pasukan Anda.

LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv1: Tanya has briefed you on the basic information of the "Dark Night" incident, and asked you to prevent "Zero", the Terrorist organization from expanding.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv2: Tanya is a double agent?! After this battle, she will go undercover among the Terrorists for more detailed intelligence!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv3: The communications machine transmits Tanya's first piece of intelligence. It seems Tanya has successfully infiltrated into the inner depths of "Zero". Now go fight the Terrorists based on this intelligence!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv4: Heavily wounded, Tanya brings valuable information that "Zero" is now intensely expanding! Please be extremely careful in attacking!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv5: The leader of "Zero" - "Faceless" Atlantis appears! He is commanding his forces to loot weapons and staff. Stop them!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv6: Tanya secretly sent a brief to you, disclosing the location where Terrorists are currently clustering. She reminds you to be vigilant of Atlantis's new plan.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv7: Tanya' s intelligence arrived in time. Jack seemed to recoil from fighting the Terrorists, however, how can you recoil and give up fighting? Just attack!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv8: Report from Jack that your troops have been ambushed by Terrorists, and have suffered heavy casualties! They need our immediate reinforcement now!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv9: Another transmission from Tanya has been received, revealing that Jack might be a traitor! But Jack has long prepared for this moment and is ready to converge with Terrorists coming to scoop him out.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv10: "Faceless" Atlantis shows up, however, Tanya is tied up in the front lines. Should an excuse be needed to rescue Tanya? Nothing can stop you even if it is a trap!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv11: Although Atlantis's complete Plan wasn't found, you've discovered 5 Terrorist cluster locations. Go wipe them out!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv12: Tanya discovered from the captured loot that Atlantis is on the verge of attacking the Central Lab! Go reinforce now!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv13: The previously repelled Terrorists are refuse to give up. They are preparing to launch forces for yet another contention on the Lab.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv14: The Terrorists' attacks continue unabated. However, Tanya suggests you research new arms to withstand the increasingly powerful Terrorists. Let's do it!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv15: The Terrorist forces amassed by Jack are ready to launch the final attack on the Lab. Battle is imminent! Prepare yourself before setting out!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv16: "Faceless" Atlantis appeared yet again and claimed to have already built up a new military force. He suddenly unleashed gunfire at you... You were saved by Tanya, however, she's badly wounded.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv17: Awakened Tanya seems to have lost her memory. Poor Tanya... For Tanya, revenge!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv18: Although it is substitute officers that are now sending you intelligence, you are unable to forget the sound of Tanya's voice. Once this battle is over, try to get Tanya's memory back!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv19: You decide to take Tanya to a place nearby the Lab with troops, to try to recover her memory.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv20: Tanya finally recovers her memory. Not only that, she has recalled Atlantis's nuclear plan! Hurry up to Zone C7 and stop Atlantis now!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv21: Tanya has received new intelligence that Terrorists have divided forces in order to kidnap the Governor. You must stop this from happening!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv22: Tanya receives new intelligence that Terrorists have divided forces to kidnap the Governor. They must be stopped!

LC_OTHER_BIGMAP_GATHER_DETAIL:
- You can find all kinds of resource tiles on the map. Send troops to gather them and obtain large amounts of resources for your base! 
- When a resource tile is being gathered by another Commander, you can send troops to defeat him and continue to gather on this tile!
- Be careful, units lost on resource tiles will not be sent back to Garage for repair!
LC_OTHER_BIGMAP_TERRITORY_DETAIL:
- After joining a guild, you can occupy tiles for your guild!
- Gathering resources on tiles which belong to your own guild will increase your gathering speed and provide additional resources for the guild Resource Bank!
- During the non-PVP period, enemies are unable to teleport to your Territory!
- The more tiles your guild occupies, the stronger your guild will be!
LC_OTHER_BIGMAP_SCOUT_DETAIL:
- Scout other players to view the number of troops and resources on their bases.
-Research scout at the Lab, and you can detect even more information!
- But please note, your scouting target will be forewarned. He might not think scouting him is a very friendly thing to do!
LC_OTHER_BIGMAP_ATTACK_DETAIL:
- This is a war game where you can launch attacks against other players!
- Units lost in attacks will not be sent back to the Garage for repair!
- When you are victorious in battle, your troops will bring back looted resources to your base!

LC_OTHER_wingman_main_page_explain:
1. There are 5 qualities of Wingmen, i.e. White, Green, Blue, Purple, and Orange. 
2. Wingman sub-attributes unlock as Wingman level upgrades, but values of sub-attributes are fixed and won't be affected by Wingman level. 
3. The main attribute of Wingman Eagle, Starlight, and Hornet contains only one unit type's combat attribute respectively. However, the main attribute of Intrepid includes combat attributes of all three main unit types. 
4. Players can get Wingman from Wingman Supply Chests obtained by completing daily missions, participating in rebel activities or other certain activities, collecting Wingman supplies, and purchasing Wingman Supply Chests at the store.
LC_OTHER_wingman_upgrade_page_explain: 1. Locked wingman cannot be consumed for an upgrade. 2. Wingman with better quality and higher level provides more EXP. 3. Wingmen at Lv3 or below won't receive EXP loss.
LC_OTHER_wingman_modification_notice:
1. You can use the Transform function to reset unlocked sub-attributes.
2. Sub-attributes can be locked, but attributes locked will not be reset in a transform.
3. You can lock a maximum of 4 sub-attributes.

LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_GUIDE_NUM1: Commander, please allow me to lead you to the CTCC, the Counterterrorism Command Center.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM1: We'll always remember August 9, 2025, when the “Dark Night” incident occured.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM2: "Dark Night" incident was the most bitter terrorist attack in history to ever take place, when the Terrorist organization "Zero" destroyed governments all over the world almost overnight!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM3: Since the "Dark Night" incident, the world has sunk into a state of chaos without any government. I have just now recieved new information that "Zero" is spawning itself again!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM4: As a victim of “Dark Night" incident, I request you, commander, to exterminate them!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM5: Commander, we got luck this time. We <font color='#ffc000'>captured</font> quite a few <font color='#ffc000'>battle troops</font>. Now, our battle ability has again been enhanced!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM6: Both capturing prisoners from Terrorists and producing at the Armory are effective ways to enhance our power!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV2_NUM1: Commander, there is something I must confess to you.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV2_NUM2: Since the "Dark Night" incident, the Terrorist organization "Zero" as well as surviving governments have all reached out to me. So, simply speaking, I'm a double agent.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV2_NUM3: I've decided to infiltrate into the inner depths of "Zero" after this extermination operation, to provide you with further intelligence!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV3_NUM1: (The special communications machine has just received a dialogue video between Tanya and a senior "Zero" official)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV3_NUM2: Sir, Field agent Tanya reporting to you!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV3_NUM3: Well, well, well, isn't this our beautiful Tanya? How is it possible that you haven't brought along several handsome studs with you?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV3_NUM4: Too bad, the handsome boys are all dead. Where is our leader? I need to talk with him.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV3_NUM5: Guess what, it's also just too bad. Our leader is recruiting near Zone A3, for THAT plan. Ha ha ha!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV4_NUM1: Commander! Please head to Zone C55 now! That's the real place "Zero" is expanding! Beware of their leader, “faceless” Atlantis!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV4_NUM3: It doesn't matter! Just came across several numbskulls on my way here. I need to hurry back to them. My real identity should not yet have been revealed.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV4_NUM4: (Leaving as Tanya finishes her words. The setting sun, however, casts her thin shadow back towards us...)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV4_NUM5: Commander, please don't be content with just the current victory. It's beyond all imagination as to just how strong the Terrorists are. Developing the base is now of the utmost importance!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV4_NUM6: As a symbol of base power, it's of prior importance for us to upgrade our <font color='#ffc000'>H.Q</font>!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV5_NUM1: Leader, what a success! Now our men can be well equipped, no bare hands anymore!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV5_NUM2: Ha ha ha! All these tanks, helicopters, and SUVs belong to me, Atlantis now!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV5_NUM3: "Faceless" Atlantis, your plan has been exposed. Surrendering is your best choice!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV5_NUM5: I'll do you a favor and send only 10% of my forces. Beat them, and you win! Hahahahaha!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV5_NUM6: Commander, it's not a good thing to underestimate an enemy. We must expand our armed forces, or else, we may stand to lose next time he comes.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM1: (Beep, beep, beep...The Communications machine for receiving Tanya's intelligence rings again.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM3: ("Atlantis is plotting out a terrible plan. Expanding his armed forces is just his first step.")
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM4: ("Stop them, Commander! We must stop them right from the very start. Tanya begs you, Commander. please! They are now at Zone D26!"
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM5: The sound of the communications machine rings again in the command room.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM6: (Tanya: Commander, Atlantis is soon going to launch a massive attack! Please be aware! Please be aware!)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM7: Commander, with all due respect, our current tactics are not suitable for tackling big enough battles.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM9: See, we have the War Simulator, which can be helpful in figuring out restrain relations among units.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV7_NUM1: Commander! Tanya has just sent us the location intelligence of "Zero" again, but...
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV7_NUM3: I think if we continue to resist and fight against "Zero", it will only bring about their all out revenge. What if we just get over it all and reconcile?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV7_NUM5: Easy, commander, I was just offering a more rational plan, whereas continuing to fight against "Zero" is definately not a smart one.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV7_NUM6: What's more, those independent forces are all turning a blind eye to the Terrorist organization.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV7_NUM8: I need to continue my duties and wait for Tanya's intelligence. Commander, if you'd like to be alone, the Shooting Ground would be the best choice.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV8_NUM1: Commander! Our troops have been ambushed by Terrorists! We are losing them! Remaining troops have now already been surrounded by Terrorists!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV8_NUM4: Commander, I think you must have noticed, our troop production cannot keep pace with the expansion of Terrorists.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV8_NUM5: If you can remember, the speedups we seized last time would come in real handy now! I suggest you use more at this moment!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM1: (Beep, beep, beep...The Communications machine for receiving Tanya's intelligence rings again.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM2: ("This is Tanya, this is Tanya! Emergency! Emergency!")
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM3: ("Jack could be a traitor! Jack could be a traitor!")
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM4: Hmm, you got me, huh? What a pity that I didn't kill you at the Shooting Ground last time!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM5: Never mind. My troops are on the way! Stop me if you can.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM6: Commander, a final piece of advice as your officer, Tanya has long been exposed. Get ready for her remains!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM7: Another thing, don't tell me you can't even take care of our base infiltrators. If so, you would have no chance to see me again. Sayonara, "commander".
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM2: Hahahahaha! Tanya, my dear, what a perfect cover you had. Any last words?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM3: Just kill me! You crazy freak!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM4: No, no, no, my dear bait! See? Your commander is right here! Take a guess, will he come and rescue you?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM5: Commander, no, don't come! It's a trap!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM7: Why... to cost such a price, just to save me....
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM9: No, I can't leave with you. It seems Atlantis is plotting an even more massive operation. I... I must find further intelligence!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM10: (Tanya's figure again dissapears in the fire of battle, but this time her footsteps seem refracted with blinking tears.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM11: (No one knows whether it was for persistence to leep striking Terrorists or for hiding her tears that Tanya turned around...)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM1: Thank you, Commander! You rescued me. That was a trap. You...)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM3: ....About "That Plan", still I couldn't dig out accurate intelligence, but what you can be sure of is, they have rallied 5 troops at Zone E41.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM4: That'll be enough. Let's set out!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM5: I'm not sure this information is good enough to repay your rescue of last time, but...
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM7: No no no, it's just too hot...hmm, it must be too...hot...
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM8: So...I just want to say, thank you for saving my life! I will alway by your side...to...to gather intelligence!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM9: Any...anyway, please take these gifts! I'll work even harder in the future!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV12_NUM1: Commander, about the last battle, seems we got something interesting - the Operation Plan of "Zero"!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV12_NUM2: Seems they are planning to attack the central Lab, soon! Are we marching to the Lab?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV12_NUM4: That's wired. Something is wrong here. There should be more forces than this.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV12_NUM5: Commander, let's enhance our scouting technique, for better knowledge of our enemy.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV14_NUM1: Commander...I think we should get some new toys.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV14_NUM2: Hmm, no no no, Tanya was saying that we can develop some new arms. Seems these Terrorists are researching new arms, too.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV14_NUM3: Oh, no! They are attacking the Lab again! Let's reinforce!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV14_NUM4: The Central Lab sends the up-to-date Helicopter design drawing in appreciation of our reinforcement.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV14_NUM5: We can research it, so that the attack of our Helicopters can be improved greatly!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM1: Tanya, my dear, it's been a long time. Well, you are at the Lab, too? A scientist you are now?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM2: Traitor! What do you want in the Lab?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM3: Oh? I thought you knew "That Plan". In this case, I'm much relieved now. Full attack!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM4: Heavens, what a fierce battle. Though we were nearly broken through, we eventually retook the Central Lab.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM5: However, people in the Lab said that Jack may have looted lots of advanced design drawings. So, to confront with them, the Lab designed the new drawing of Tank - Grizzly!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM6: So, we got a new toy! Let's make some of them! Haha!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM8: Uh...I mean let's make some Grizzly Tanks!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV16_NUM1: Hahaha, look what we got at the Lab! Let's try it out!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV16_NUM3: Oh? Isn't this Tanya's commander? You've come just at the right moment! Let's just try my new weapon on him! Ha ha ha! Forces... fire!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV16_NUM4: (Tanya is flung upon you in that instant...)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV16_NUM6: (The blast wave from the explosion shocks Tanya into unconsciousness )
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV17_NUM1: Where... Where am I?... Who am I?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV18_NUM1: (While Tanya had lost her memory, another officer passed along a piece of terrorist intelligence.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV18_NUM2: (Not having the intelligence signed off by Tanya, seems very strange.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV18_NUM6: I... I don't know. There's some drawings in my head... some kind of new weapon...
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV19_NUM1: Central Lab... No, it's not Artillery, but something more powerful...
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV19_NUM2: Take me to the front, maybe I can remember something.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV19_NUM4: (The bell sounds again warning that Terrorists are sneaking in...)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV19_NUM5: They dare to come again?! For the drawings?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV19_NUM8: (Shooting through the air in a flash, the bullet penetrates Tanya's shoulder who stands in front of you.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV20_NUM3: Commander... I think I've got my memory back!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV20_NUM4: Not only that, now I remember, "Faceless" Atlantis is going to make a nuclear bomb!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV20_NUM5: Raising troops was for getting forces to attack the Lab. Attacking the Lab was for stealing nuclear tech. The nuclear will be built on Greenland!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV20_NUM7: Look who I've brought, Miss Lisa is a senior scientific researcher. She has been specially dispatched by the Central Lab to be our advisor!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV21_NUM1: Hahaha, Tanya, my dear, how did you find this place?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV21_NUM2: Simple, expand forces, attack the Lab, seize Greenland, isn't all this for the nuclear bomb!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV21_NUM3: Smart girl! But it's really a pity you can't give me your allegiance. But seeing as you found your way here, try and attack!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV21_NUM4: But I must remind you, it will only be 3 days before the nuclear is completed! So, just come and attack! Ha ha ha!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV22_NUM1: Commander, a message from Central Government, Terrorists have surrounded the Government building!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV22_NUM2: Damn! That's why Atlantis deliberately told us the time left for making the nuclear bomb. He was trying to hold us up here.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV22_NUM3: Commander, are we staying here or going back to rescue them?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV24_NUM1: Commander, Atlantis has surrounded us. I think we'd better crush them one by one.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV25_NUM1: You! You think you can prevent me from kidnapping the Governor and from launching the nuclear bomb? Naive!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV25_NUM2: Atlantis! A nuclear bomb will not be the least bit good for anyone!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV25_NUM3: Is this not very fair? Ha ha ha! Is that not what you care about the most, freedom and peace? Now, I'll just give you the ultimate freedom and peace, ha ha ha ha!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV25_NUM4: Only half an hour before the nuclear bomb is launched! If you can stop it, just go ahead and try! Ha ha ha ha!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV25_NUM5: You think I'm the only one who can launch a nuclear bomb?! What a fool, how many times will you make the same mistake?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV25_NUM6: Never lower your guard, and always watch your back, because "Zero" is everywhere!

LC_POPBOX_PVE_info_city:
Redwolf Legions are the Invader's elite troops. Their powerful battle ability makes them fear nothing. They garrison around Cities and will inevitably become enemies if you want to liberate a City.

1. Attacking Redwolf Legions won't consume any Action Points;
2. Redwolf Legions will be refreshed daily on 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00 (UTC).
3. Defeating Redwolf Legions will greatly increase your Officer's XP.

LC_POPBOX_PVE_info_01:
Iron Behemoths are the Invader's military strongholds, which are equipped with heavy weapons that can destroy anything. You will need to assemble a batch of strong troops to eliminate them.

1. Attacking Iron Behemoths will cost 150 Action Points each time, and your troops will not die during the attacks.
2. Iron Behemoths can only be rally attacked after you join a Guild.
3. Pay attention to Zone News, which can tell you when higher level Iron Behemoths appear on the map.
4. Defeat Iron Behemoths to obtain amazing rewards. The stronger you are, the better the rewards will be.
5. Keep your eyes on the Iron Behemoth countdown. It won't just stay there and wait for you, so make sure you defeat it before it retreats.
LC_POPBOX_ExerciseRhine_Enemy_Info:
A troop from the Exercise Rhine. Defeat it to challenge higher level maneuvering troops.

1. Only the Commander who summons maneuvering troops has the qualification to challenge unless the Commander uses Help Request Tickets.
2. You will only suffer small losses when attacking maneuvering troops, and all Wounded units will be recovered once they return to the City.
3. Attacking maneuvering troops will cost Action Points, which will be restored over time.
4. You can attack maneuvering troops solo or through rally attacks.
5. You can obtain a huge amount of Officer XP from solo attacks, and you can obtain abundant resources plus Help Request Tickets with a certain chance from rally attacks.
6. You can only challenge maneuvering troops with higher difficulties after defeating the maneuvering troops at the current level.
LC_POPBOX_ExerciseRhine_Boss_Info:
A Boss from the Exercise Rhine. Defeat it to obtain amazing rewards.

1. Only the Guild that summons the Boss has the qualification to challenge.
2. Each Commander can only send one troop to join the attack.
3. Commanders who participated in the attack will obtain rewards after the Boss is defeated.
LC_POPBOX_Troops_FullAttention_Text1: Full marching queues. You can obtain marching queues by upgrading HQ level. Or you can dispatch your other units that are on missions.
LC_POPBOX_B2_RW_buff_info:
Badges dropped by the Redwolf Legions can provide powerful boosts for Commanders. Please note:
1. You can only have one Badge effect at the same time. The newly obtained Badge effect will replace the old one.
2. One Badge can be obtained by several Commanders. Once obtained, the Badge effects will apply to all units.
3. There will be a countdown for each Badge, and the Badge will disappear once the countdown ends.

LC_POPBOX_Shield_Rule_D:
1.When you send troops to launch an attack, occupy territory, encamp, participate in the Rally, Defend, or Reinforce, you won’t be able to activate the shield.

3. A Governor cannot activate a Peace Shield. Once a player becomes the Governor, his/her current Peace Shield will be automatically disabled.

4.When your base is in the Restricted Area, you cannot activate the shield.

LC_POPBOX_TT_info:
*The Top Territory can be occupied by any guild from any zone on this continent.

*After a guild occupies the Top Territory, all the guild members can enjoy the buff brought by doing so.

*You can only attack the Top Territory during the activity period. 

*One guild can only occupy one Top territory.

*In Top Territory, if a player changes to another guild, he will immediately be sent back to his original zone.
LC_POPBOX_Setwar_notice1: Hanya pemimpin Pasukan bisa deklarasikan perang.
LC_POPBOX_Setwar_notice2: Deklarasi perang berhasil dilakukan! Persiapkan diri untuk menghadapi pertempuran!
LC_POPBOX_TT_info2:
*The ruling rights to this territory can be acquired by occupying the Council. The occupying guild‘s leader will become the Council Chairman. 

*The attacking party can occupy the Council after defeating the defending party. The defending party has to defend the attack for 12 hours or wait until the end of the activity to gain the ruling rights. 

*The guild members with their commander inside the Council will automatically become the defense captains, all buffs for the Council defending party are gained from defense captains. 

*The troop capacity of Council is 2,375,000, and the maximum capacity of Hall of War when attacking the Council will also be limited to 2,375,000.

*In the following 5 days after acquiring ruling rights, all ruling guild members can teleport into the territory where the Council is located at any time. 

*All members of the guild occupying the Council will enjoy the buffs provided by the Council, no matter whether their bases are in this territory or not. 

*All resources gathered in the territory will have an extra 10% of the total entered into the occupying guild's Resource Bank.

*There will be much higher battle losses on the Top Territory.
LC_POPBOX_PP_info1:
*The ruling right of the Presidential Palace can be acquired by occupying the Presidential Palace. The occupying guild‘s leader will become the President who rules over all of the zones!!

*The attacking party can occupy the Presidential Palace after defeating the defending party. The defending party has to defend the attack for 3 days to gain ruling rights.

*The guild members with their commander inside the Presidential Palace will automatically become the defense captains, all buffs for the Presidential Palace defending party are gained from defense captains.

*The President can title all the zones except for the Top Territory, the players of the said zones will be affected by the zone title.

*In the following 5 days after acquiring ruling rights, all ruling guild members can teleport into the territory where the Presidential Palace is located at any time.

*All members of the guild occupying the Presidential Palace will enjoy the buffs provided by the Presidential Palace, no matter whether their bases are in this territory or not.

*All resources gathered in the territory will have an extra 10% of the total entered into the occupying guild's Resource Bank.

*When the main base is inside the Presidential Palace territory,  the Hall of War and Unit Reserve Center's capacity will be increased by 100%. Meanwhile, the battle loss ratio will increase. 

*The troop capacity of President Palace is 4,750,000, and the maximum capacity of Hall of War when attacking the President Palace will also be limited to 4,750,000.
LC_POPBOX_War_info1:
* Pasukan bisa deklarasikan perang satu kali untuk mendapatkan satu Wilayah Top per kegiatan

* Setelah melakukan deklarasi perang, pasukan tidak bisa mencabut deklarasi. Selain itu, ongkos deklarasi perang adalah Uang 30.000.000.

LC_POPBOX_UD_info:
* When Extreme Defense begins, Terrorist Bases will be refreshed on the map. Guild Leaders can select a Terrorist Base and start a round of Extreme Defense.
* Then Terrorist Bases will send troops to randomly attack guild members. Commanders can get points by defending their base or reinforcing guild members' bases to kill enemy troops.
* Terrorists do not plunder Commanders' resources. However, small amounts of losses (units) will be incurred, which will enter the Garage. Lost Reinforcements will also be sent to their own Garage. (Please make sure there is enough capacity in Garage, since units exceeding the capacity will be permanently "lost".)
* If Commanders lose during Extreme Defense, they will no longer be attacked by Terrorists. Players can activate a Peace Shield to announce giving up.
* Once a Guild has activated the activity, newly joined Commanders will not be able to get any points or be attacked by Terrorists.
* Once a Guild has activated the activity, newly signed up Commanders will not be attacked by Terrorists, but they can get points through reinforcement.
* While the activity is ongoing, Commanders who quit the Guild or join another Guild will have their personal points reset to zero. If Terrorists are attacking you while you are quitting the current guild or joining another one, you will be taken as lost the Extreme Defense activity.
* Rewards will be sent to Rewards Center when the activity is over.
