LC_VIDEO_video_channel_create_info_desc:
Ready to submit your YouTube/TikTok video to Dead Empire Channel?

There are tons of perks to adding your videos to Dead Empire Channel. For example, after approval, every video view on YouTube/TikTok earns you 1 V-Coin. The more views your videos get, the more V-Coin you'll receive!

Here are a few things to know before submitting your videos:

1. It's for Everyone:
Your video has to be about Dead Empire, but you don't need to be a pro YouTuber. We accept any videos as long as they're about Dead Empire.

2. Video Approval:
After you submit your YouTube/TikTok video, the Dead Empire team will review it to make sure the content is about Dead Empire and follows platform and Dead Empire rules. The review usually takes 1-7 days.

3. V-Coin Reward:
Once your video is approved, you'll earn V-Coin for new views on YouTube/TikTok. The current rate is 1 V-Coin per view. The numbers update every hour.

4. Get More Followers:
Dead Empire Channel shows your videos to our players, helping you get more subscribers and followers on YouTube and TikTok.

5. Your Content, Your Responsibility:
Only add videos you made yourself. You're responsible for your content. Breaking the rules could limit your account.

6. Rule Changes:
Dead Empire may change the rules in the future. By using the app, you agree to follow the current rules and any future changes.

---------------------------------
Extra Note:
*Reward starts when the video is submitted and approved on Dead Empire Channel, the previous views of the video would not be included. 
*If you remove the video from Dead Empire, the video stops generate rewards, but you can still claim the rewards already generated.
*The third-party data service used by Dead Empire includes anti-cheat mechanisms, which strictly monitor and filter view data to provide a more accurate assessment of interactions. As a result, the number of views reported may differ from the original data on the video platform.
*Dead Empire may apply limits over the maximum reward a video can get.
*Certain actions may lead to account banning and reward removal, for example faking views, using other people's videos, spamming videos and etc.
*Dead Empire may change the rules in the future. By using the app, you agree to follow the rules and any future changes.
LC_VIDEO_video_channel_creator_info_desc:
Creators are players who have added their YouTube/TikTok videos to the Dead Empire Channel.
In Dead Empire Channel, creators not only earn V-Coin rewards every time their video is played on YouTube/TikTok, but also get more exposure as Dead Empire players check out the videos and become YouTube subscribers and TikTok followers.

Here are a few things to know about becoming a Creator:

1. It's for Everyone:
You don't have to be a pro YouTuber to become a creator on Dead Empire Channel. Just make videos about Dead Empire in your own style, upload them to YouTube or TikTok, and link the video to Dead Empire Channel. You'll become a creator!

2. Video Requirements:
All submitted videos go through an approval process to ensure they meet our basic requirements. These include: the video must be about Dead Empire and must not violate any platform or Dead Empire rules.

3. V-Coin Reward:
Once your video is approved, you will earn V-Coin for new views on YouTube/TikTok. The current rate is 1 V-Coin per video view. The numbers update every hour.

4. Get More Followers:
Dead Empire Channel showcases your videos to our players, helping you get more subscribers and followers on YouTube and TikTok.

5. Your Content, Your Responsibility:
Only add videos you made yourself. You're responsible for your content. Breaking the rules could limit your account.

6. Rule Changes:
Dead Empire may change the rules in the future. By using the app, you agree to follow the rules and any future changes.

---------------------------------
Extra Note:
*Reward starts when the video is submitted and approved on Dead Empire Channel, the previous views of the video would not be included. 
*If you remove the video from Dead Empire, the video stops generate rewards, but you can still claim the rewards already generated.
*Dead Empire uses its own algorithm to filter repeated and fake views, your video views might be different from the views on the video platforms. 
*Dead Empire may apply limits over the maximum reward a video can get.
*Certain actions may lead to account banning and reward removal, for example faking views, using other people's videos, spamming videos and etc.
*Dead Empire may change the rules in the future. By using the app, you agree to follow the rules and any future changes.

LC_VIDEO_window_video_channel_create_ins:
Create a video introducing Dead Empire! It can be casual or serious, and you can even just use screen recording.

Making videos about Dead Empire not only earns you V-Coins but also attracts new subscribers to your channel!

Check out some great examples below.

Dead Empire Channel is where you showcase your videos to players and earn V-Coin rewards. Your videos stay on your YouTube channel or TikTok account.

1. Upload to YouTube or TikTok:
First, upload your video to your YouTube channel or TikTok account.

2. Make Your Channel Public:
Make sure your channel/account is set to public and your video is publicly accessible before submitting it to Dead Empire Channel.

There will be a text verification stage where we verify your ownership over the video, so make sure you only submit videos of your own.

Submitting your video to Dead Empire Channel is super easy, and we'll guide you through the process.

1. Get Your Video URL:
You need the URL of your YouTube or TikTok video.

2. Add Verification Text:
Make sure to include the verification text in your video description.

3. Review Process:
After you submit, there will be a short review period. The Dead Empire team will check your video to make sure it meets the requirements. This usually takes 1-7 days.

Once your video is approved, every new view on YouTube or TikTok will earn you V-Coin rewards. For every 1 view, you get 1 V-Coin, with no cap! Just sit back and watch the numbers grow! 

Sharing the video with your friends will get you even more views!

The rewards will be automatically added to your Earning Balance, and you can claim them anytime you like.

A video is worth a thousand words! That's why we need more videos : )
Check out the video for a more detailed walkthrough.

In the V-Coin Store, use the V-Coins you earn from creating videos to exchange for a variety of in-game rewards!

Below is the Exchange Guide:

1. Product Categories
Store goods are divided into four types:

Limited Goods: Rare items, usually with exchange limits

Weekly Goods: Limited exchanges, inventory refreshes weekly

Daily Goods: Limited exchanges, updated daily

Standard Goods: Unlimited supply, exchange anytime

2. Exchange Process
Directly use V-Coins in the V-Coin Store to exchange for your desired goods. Once the exchange is successful, the items will be immediately delivered to your game account.

3. How to Earn V-Coins
Create Dead Empire-related videos on YouTube or TikTok and submit them for review to the official channel. Once your video is approved, you will earn 1 V-Coin for every view it receives on YouTube/TikTok! The more views your video gets, the more V-Coin rewards you will receive!

Tutorial_Research_4: Okay! Getting potential projects started is a pressing matter at the moment!
Tutorial_Research_5: Here's some information on the projects, and it's really detailed.
Tutorial_Research_7: We have <color=#E3B939>consumption</color> for this project recorded here.
Tutorial_Research_8: Here you can see the potential <color=#E3B939>revenue</color> this project generates.
Tutorial_Research_9: Here we record the <color=#E3B939>estimated time</color> needed for research. Let's get it started!
Tutorial_Research_10: According to our experts, for some urgent projects, we can apply special Research Speed Ups to reduce research time!

Tutorial_Research_12: We need to choose one aspect from Economy, Combat, and Production.

Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_1: After three days of battling, we've finally taken down this city. It's our base now. Though the Invaders are out there ready to assault us any time, we can at least have peace for a moment.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_2: Constantly ravaged by wars, all cities have become barren lands. As the head of this city, I must protect it.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_29: Listen! You have 30 minutes to get out of this city. We're taking it over!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_32: Not only Tanks but air support? We can't deal with this, retreat!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_35: Linda was missing just like that... I scoured the area being bombed, only metal and debris. I kept looking for Linda until one day, I received a note.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_36:
GIVE UP THE CITY OR SHE'S DEAD
Was scrawled across the photo.
I regret I didn't stop her that day.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_37: I must save her, but I can't lead the troops on my own. I know that someone can help me. I have faith in her.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_38: Hello, Commander! Here to fix something, are you?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_41: This area is suitable for a Garage. Be quick. We set out immediately after repairing these Tanks.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_44: Okay, I'm sorry. You're a competent Commander. I'm just worried about Linda. Sorry I rushed you.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_46: I don't know. We just need to search for her bit by bit. Destroy all the Invaders we find, and I'm sure we can get something useful.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_47: These Invaders look suspicious! Let's start with them!
Tutorial_Opening_BGStory1: Wars among European countries have lasted for years.
Tutorial_Opening_BGStory2: The Evil Invaders took their chance and rose up. The darkness is about to rule all of Europe.
Tutorial_Opening_BGStory3: At this very moment, only the bravest of the Resistance is still standing and fighting against them.
Tutorial_Opening_BGStory4: You and they are the only hope for Europe!
Tutorial_New_Fte_Option_2: Can we build a Tank Armory?
Tutorial_New_Fte_Feedback_5: Marjorie thinks you aren't doing your duty
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_34_B: You idiots, you'll pay for this. Now, attaaack!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_content: We need to share information on Pandora tanks with other forces and find out the way to deal with it. We need allies. Join or create a Guild, mobilize all forces to decode the Pandora secret and solve the enemies!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_5: Give the order, Commander! Now it's in an emergency, you can assign me to manage resources, I will find ways to increase resource output.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_10: I have nothing to do now, Commander. Just waiting for construction works to complete. Can we find a way to accelerate the process?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_12: Speedup? Wow, cool! With that, we can definitely take the lead!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_22: Thanks to your attack, Invaders are in chaos now! I took the chance and escaped. Heading to your base right now!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_16: Thanks for your help, Commander! Evelyn, at your command now!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_Hero_Back_Content: Commander, don't worry. I'm trying as fast as I can to get to your base and support you!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_Hero_Back_Desc: {0} will arrive at and join your City when the countdown ends.
Tutorial_Fte_CG_WouldOutlook_1: 1941, Invaders launched blitzkriegs and swept over the whole Europe.
Tutorial_Fte_CG_WouldOutlook_2: Countries fell one after another. Small and big cities were all occupied by Invaders.
Tutorial_Fte_CG_WouldOutlook_4: Soviet forces are holding their positions, and the US army has also arrived with their ships.
Tutorial_Fte_CG_WouldOutlook_5: As a Commander, you led the girls cross the fire, and took a city from enemies.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_content_a: The resistance is getting stronger, and the secrets of Pandora will be finally revealed. But before that, you have to make your Officers even more powerful.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_2_a: Evelyn? Is that the Officer you mentioned earlier who is still being held by the Invaders?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_6_a: It's time to find out Officer Evelyn's location, besides I'm quite curious about what exactly Project Pandora is.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_content_a: A letter from a mysterious woman. Who is she exactly? She didn't have to risk all of this if she's one of the Invaders. We must become stronger if we want to help Evelyn escape.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_1_a: {0}, don't be surprised that I know your name, and trust me, you have no idea what else I know.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_2_a: Don't try to guess who I am first. Evelyn is the thing we have to focus on now. I will help her escape, but I need you to distract the Invaders.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_3_a: Make that happen, so Evelyn can stand a chance of escaping. As for me, I believe we'll meet soon.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_6_a: Well done. Evelyn has made her escape from the Invaders, and she will arrive at your location in {0} hour(s) as planned.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_7_a: Keep fighting against Pandora. I look forward to meeting you.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_1_a: Please make sure to destroy Pandora, Commander.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_2_a: They are the special troops the Invaders secretly created. They are strong, but what's worse is they are almost everywhere.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_3_a: Each Pandora troop's location is hidden among different Invader troops.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_4_a: Trust me, you cannot easily destroy Pandora on your own. You need to make allies with other Commanders, and fight against it together.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_6_a: That's it! Find it, and destroy it with your Guild!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_content_a: With the intel Evelyn gathered, the secrets of Pandora are starting to unravel. This could be the key to turning the tide. But we need allies. Join or create a Guild, so we can have enough strength to fight against Pandora.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_Hero_Back_ready: Commander, thanks for your help. I still need to wait for the plane before returning to your base.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_8_a: Evelyn's intel on Project Pandora is recorded on this tape. She asked me to bring it to you.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_9_a: I hope what we've done can really help Evelyn.
Tutorial_Soldier_ChooseAgent_1:
Commander, 3 new agents have been dispatched to our army.
You can choose 1 of them to be your assistant.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_5: Commander, what's on your mind? It's not a good time to stare at me.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_6: Upon your request, I've investigated the city surroundings. The situation is worse than we expected.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_7: Do you need me to explain this to you more specifically? Briefing isn't my strength.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_8: Alright, I hope you can understand.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_10: In fact, our base is surrounded by the Invaders, and they may attack us at any time because we're at war.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_11: In order to resist them, we can only rely on ourselves.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_12: Commander, I believe you've figured out a plan. It's you who led us take this city after all, and I don't want to be a captive.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_13: It would be better if we have more advanced weapons. These common troops are starting to make me feel less safe.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_14: Tanks? Yeah, I like these big guys that will make our enemies scared.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_15: I can't be more excited at the thought of having these super weapons, and I can't wait any longer to stand in front of these iron beasts.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_16: Oh, I'm sorry. I was too excited. Let's hurry up and build the Armory.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_17: This area is perfect for building a Tank Armory. I looked over the city and picked this one out just for you.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_18: Great! We have our own Tank Armory now! Why not produce some and see what they are capable of? These big guys make me feel safe.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_19: Tap [Produce] to start producing Tanks. The Armory capacity is still low, but producing 20 at once is not out of the question.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_20:
That's it! Tanks! With them, we'll definitely win!
Such a great day. Wanna have a drink with me, Commander?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_21: We hardly have any spare time. I'm going to the Club. Meet you there.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_22: Commander, you're here. We just opened this pub this morning. We could use some R&R occasionally, right?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_23: Commander, I think you've misunderstood. We're not as close as you imagine.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_24: Oh, a nice gift. Why not just say it. Do you feel shy to face me?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_25: Don't misunderstand this, it's only because of the gift...
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_26: An enemy attack? Those basters really know the perfect timing.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_27: Don't stop me, Commander. This is a great chance to test our Tanks!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_30: 30 minutes? I doubt that you can hold on for that long.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_31: Here, let's show you what it can do!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_33: What a coward. But I won't let you run away so easily.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_39:
Maria was caught? My bestie Maria?
What the hell's wrong with you? Want me to fix you first?!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_40: Now the Tanks are all damaged. Are you still sitting there doing nothing? Get up and build a Garage. We can't save Linda without troops.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_42: Good. Luckily Maria has defeated the enemies. Resources in the city are fully stored, and there will still be plenty of them after we repairing all the damaged Tanks. This is much faster than producing new Tanks.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_45: We can rescue Maria if we have enough troops. Let's do this, Commander.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_48:
Wait, there's a suspicious map on this Invader.
...It's a lead to Maria's location, just as I expected. But the situation is a little bit complicated. Let's head back to the base first.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_49: The map shows that Maria is being held in an Invader's base. I know those coordinates, but I'm afraid our troops are not enough.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_50: I've made a plan to deal with those Invaders. At least we have to get ourselves fully prepared before rescue Maria.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_52: Thank you, Commander. I knew you'd come for me.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_53: By the way, when I was captured, I overheard them talking about some plan code-named Pandora. It seems like they've also captured other senior Officers. We must keep an eye on them.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_mc_penelop: Commander, I'm good to go. Evelyn is in danger, and I want to rescue her as soon as possible.

Yes. Invaders are working on the project Pandora, and as a doctor, Evelyn used to treat wounds for officers who are responsible for the project out of humanism. She will be our key to destroying the project Pandora.
Slow down, Maria. The Invaders are getting stronger every day, so we must get ourselves fully prepared before saving others.
You're right. The Invaders' power is starting to worry me. Give the orders, Commander. I must put myself together!
Commander, we've just received a mysterious letter, with Evelyn's location on it!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_mc_penelop: Commander, a plane from the Government is heading towards us. Could it be Evelyn?
Another letter from that woman, Commander.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_6: Upon your request, I've investigated the city surroundings. The situation is worse than we expected.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_7: Do you need a detailed report from me?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_10: In fact, our base is surrounded by the Invaders, and they may attack us at any time because we're at war.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_11: In order to resist them, we can only rely on ourselves.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_12: Commander, even the Invaders' overwhelming strength makes me feel worried, I still believe in you.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_13: We need more powerful weapons. This will be the key to winning the war.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_15: Tanks are the nightmare of infantry. I feel scared every time I hear their names.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_16: Sorry, perhaps it's because I'm from an infantry too. Let's start building the Armory.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_17: This area is perfect for building a Tank Armory.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_18: Great. Now our enemies' endless nightmares will be produced from here! Let's produce some Tanks.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_19: Tap [Produce] to start producing Tanks. The Armory capacity is still low, but producing 20 at once is not out of the question.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_20:
That's it! Tanks! With them, I'm more confident in the upcoming battles!
Commander, wanna have a drink with me?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_21: It's time to take a break. I'll wait for you in the Club.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_22: Commander, you're here. We just opened this pub this morning. Although I'm not feeling very comfortable here, we still need a place to ease our mind.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_24: Oh, it's a gift. Sorry, I misunderstood you.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_25: Um... I'm not used to this. But...
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_26: Alert! It should an enemy attack!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_27: I'll let them know they're fighting for their stupidity!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_33: I won't let you run away!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_39:

Tutorial_LegionMission_Division_2: The Allies' counterattack has started. All Guilds should be ready to take back the middle-sized and small cities from our enemies. After occupying these cities, our troops can garrison them to prepare for bigger attacks.
Tutorial_LegionMission_Corps_1: All Commanders, we're going to launch a full assault to break down the defensive lines of the enemy capital.
Tutorial_LegionMission_Corps_2: All Commanders should upgrade their troops with T3 military technologies and boost their power to the next level. Only then can we defeat them.
Tutorial_LegionMission_Army_1: Commanders, we have come to the very point of this war. Our enemies have equipped their armored units with T4 military technologies.
Tutorial_LegionMission_Army_2: Now I command you all to research T4 military technologies and achieve mass production as soon as possible. We need them to be on the battlefield!
Tutorial_HqInstitution_Intro:
The basement has been developed greatly.
The whole army will be promoted to a higher Institution.
Please start the upgrading of HQ.
Tutorial_b2_expedition_talk_1:
Welcome to Campaign mode, Commander.
There are many maneuvers to challenge and you can get rewards after completing them. 
Please Tap on <color=#ffd666>CHALLENGE</color> button to enter the first maneuver.
Tutorial_b2_expedition_talk_2:
Every maneuver has different goals, complete them all to get 3-star rating.
Now we can <color=#ffd666>Dispatch Troops</color> first.
Tutorial_b2_expedition_talk_3:
Congratulations! You have completed the first maneuver!
Remember, the higher star rated, the more rewards you get.
Tutorial_b2_expedition_talk_4:
If you cann't complete a manuever, please <color=#ffd666>Improve your Officers and Troops</color>, and then challenge again.
After all, challenging will <color=#ffd666>Cost Nothing</color>. Please enjoy and go on!
Tutorial_MiniMap_chat_7: Prepare yourself. We could launch the full assault at any time.
Tutorial_slg_battle_chat01: Commander, we've besieged enemy elite troops. Destroy them to capture their supplies!
Tutorial_academy_introduce_01: Let's get to know our new Officer first. She has been waiting for you at XXX.
Tutorial_academy_introduce_02: Hello, Commander! I'm Linda. I'm honored to be able to join your army. I would like to know what missions you will assign me.
Tutorial_academy_introduce_03: Copy that, Commander! You will see my capabilities soon! This is a nice place. We can communicate, play games, and relax here. You can find me here when you need me. See you.
Tutorial_Openning_subtitle_02: Our scouts discovered an enemy supply train
Tutorial_Openning_subtitle_04: Powerful enough to wipe out all ally camps in this area
Tutorial_Openning_subtitle_05: You must intercept and destroy it
Tutorial_Openning_subtitle_06: Sir, it is a fortress on wheels
Tutorial_Openning_subtitle_07: I need reinforcements, a hundred guns at least
Tutorial_Openning_subtitle_08: Speaking of reinforcements, they are already here, special operation forces
Tutorial_Openning_subtitle_09: Don’t be fooled by their looks,
Tutorial_Openning_subtitle_10: Yes, they are beautiful, But with them, looks can kill
Tutorial_Openning_subtitle_11: Wow, that uh... sounds too good to be ture, sir
Tutorial_Openning_subtitle_14: I’ve seen them tear up an entire enemy platoon with their bare hands
Tutorial_slg_start_chat_6: Our troops have returned to the base. Now we need to find an excellent Officer to lead them. Follow me.
Tutorial_slg_battle_chat_10: Powerful Officers will be key to victories in future battles!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_3: This new recruit, Linda, I remember her name. Though she lacks experience, I can see her fiery passion in her eyes, and thanks to her performances during previous battles, we can finally take the city back.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_4: Sometimes, I wonder if, if she could get closer...
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_5: Commander? What's on your mind? You keep staring off into the distance.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_6: Upon your request, I've investigated the city surroundings. The situation is worse than we expected.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_7: I'd like to brief you right now. (It looks she really wants to impress me)
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_8: Great! I've been waiting for this for too long. Now I'll start.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_9: Ugh, sorry to rush you, but I want you to hear all about it. It's important.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_10: To be frank, we're besieged by the Invaders. The war is still there, and they could attack us at any time.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_11: We must bolster our defenses to repel them.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_12: I believe you've got plans for this. After all, you're the one leading us in taking back the city. I'm really looking forward to what you've got coming.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_13: But I'm afraid we can't beat them with common battle units. If we could utilize...
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_14: Yes, Tanks are exactly what we need to win this battle!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_15: If you'll allow me, I think this iron fortress is essential when at war. It's also my favorite. I bet you've never been inside a Tank before. I remember the first time I...
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_16: Sorry I get too excited when it comes to Tanks. I'm sorry to interrupt your building work.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_17: This area is perfect for building a Tank Armory. I looked over the city and picked this one out just for you.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_18: Wow! We're going to have our own Tank Armory! How about we produce some and take them out for a ride? I'm also a master at tank racing!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_19: Tap [Produce] to start producing Tanks. The Armory capacity is still low, but producing 20 at once is not out of the question.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_20:
That's it! Tanks! With them, we'll definitely win!
Such a great day. Wanna have a drink with me, Commander?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_21: We hardly have any spare time. I'm going to the Club. Meet you there.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_22: Commander, you're here. We just opened this pub this morning. We could use some R&R occasionally, right?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_23: Commander, I thought you were a gentleman? Ugh, I'm sorry, I didn't know you wanted to give me something?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_24: Ahh, the latest tank blueprints! Oh my god, I can't believe this. How did you get it?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_25: Commander, I know this may not be the most appropriate time to tell you this. But I can't help it, I...
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_26: What? We're under attack now? Nuts!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_27: They need to know what I'm capable of.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_30: Nuts! Our Commander knew you would come. See these Tanks? They were prepared just for you!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_31: Here, let's show you what it can do!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_33: Huh, you think you can escape me? No way!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_34: You idiots, you'll pay for this. Set off the bombs!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_39:
Linda was caught? My bestie Linda?
What the hell's wrong with you? Want me to fix you first?!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_40: Now the Tanks are all damaged. Are you still sitting there doing nothing? Get up and build a Garage. We can't save Linda without troops.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_42: Good! Linda defeated the enemies, so the resources here are well preserved, good enough to repair these Tanks. This is much faster than producing new ones.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_43: We need to hurry up, Commander! There's no time to wait. Where are your Speed Ups? Use them all!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_45: With these Tanks, we can take Linda back. Let's move out now, Commander.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_48:
Wait, we've got this map from them.
…… It is about Linda. The situation's complicated. Let's head back to the base first.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_49: The map shows Linda is imprisoned in a base of Invaders. I know this location, but I'm afraid we can't take her out with the troops we have now.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_50: To deal with enemies at this level, I've got a plan. We need to do these things first before we can save Linda.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_52: Thank you, Commander. I knew you'd come for me.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_53: By the way, when I was captured, I overheard them talking about some plan code-named Pandora. It seems like they've also captured other senior Officers. We must keep an eye on them.
Tutorial_New_Fte_Option_4: Do you know where is Linda?
Tutorial_New_Fte_Feedback_2: Linda is glad you agree with her
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_54: Commander, it's not time for this. We need to save Linda first!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_content: Pandora, a highly classfied plan, could be the key to victory of this war. But now, we have no resources to rescue Evelyn. The whole city is in short of supplies. We need Food to make cans and Steel to forge weapons.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_content: Pandora's secret has surfaced little by little with Evelyn's telegram. This could be the key to ending Invaders!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_1: What? Commander, we aren't going to save Evelyn? I don't need any rest at all!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_2: I understand you, but we don't have any resources, no matter Food or Steel.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_3: I didn't know war can cost so much... But Evelyn is in danger, we can't leave her behind.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_4: Calm down, Linda. We can work together, restore the base and rescue Evelyn as soon as we can.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_6: Hey, Commander. Some areas around the base can be used to build resource buildings.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_7: But, it's far from enough only relying on resources produced on base. There are abundant resources outside the base, try to gather some, Commander.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_8: I can lead troops to gather resources.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_9: This is time-consuming work, so specify the target to gather and I will handle the rest.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_10: Well done, Commander. Our Food storage has increased a lot. We can now say goodbye to canned food.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_11: Steel storage has also increased. It won't be long before we can forge weapons.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_12: We have to set off now to look for Officer Evelyn. I want to know more about the Pandora plan.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_13: Sorry to interrupt, Commander. I've gotten in touch with Evelyn! This is from her!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_1: Linda, please must tell your Commander about this.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_2: I've been forced to participate in the Pandora plan, which involves important technical solutions on manufacturing Pandora tanks.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_3: Yesterday, a team with classified Pandora documents just left the research lab. If you can attack Invaders and find the encrypted notes, you can unveil the secret of Pandora tanks.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_4: If you succeed, the Invaders here may enter chaos and I can find a chance to escape.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_5: We need to find those documents. People are afraid of Pandora tanks. If its secret is exposed, there will be more forces up against them. Wish us good luck, Commander!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_6: Now we can produce Tank Destroyers.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_7: With these troops. we can deal with enemy tanks easily. It would be better if we have an Officer good at leading Tank Destroyers.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_9: No, no, not me. What I like more is the power that a tank brings. But I know Officers who are experts in that. You will meet them later.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_13: Upgrade armory technologies to increase unit production speed.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_14: Got it! Now we can produce more units. I hope they can become car factories again one day. I like tanks, and I like convertibles more. But I don't have a choice now.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_15: Try to cause troubles to enemies, then they won't have the energy to notice what's our real goal.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_16: Hey, that's it! Intelligence remains intact. We've finally found it!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_17: Those classified documents are related to the design of Pandora tanks, exactly the weapon that helped Invaders win the war.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_18: I've seen one Pandora tank. It's a total nightmare. I would never want to encounter another one.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_19: No design is perfect. With these documents, we can find out its Achilles' heel.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_4: We've decoded the secret of Pandora tanks. They are powerful, but far from invincible. There are a few weak spots at the rear sides. Aiming any one of them can just blow a tank up!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_5: We can surely use that. If there are enough soldiers, and with good teamwork, we can siege Pandora tanks and attack their weak spots from the back. We need more men, Commander!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_6: It looks we need a Guild. The seed of resistance won't die. We are not alone here. Let's unite other forces to fight together!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_7: Commander, we can join a Guild or create a new one. It's up to you. Ready to make some friends?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_8: Let me tell you more about Guild business.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_9: The most obvious benefit is we can reduce the construction time of Guild members by sending Guild Help. Of course, they can return the favor in the same way.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_10: All Guild members can claim Territory Wages through Guild Territory. The amount is correlated with the size of your Guild Territory. Only the Guild Leader and Officials can expand your Guild Territory.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_1_Dialog_1: This is probably a sudden request, but I know an Officer called Evelyn who was forced to participate in the Pandora plan and is now captivated in an Invaders' base. We need to rescue her as well.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_20: Don't be afraid of Pandora tanks, I will help you.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_21: Evelyn? Is that Evelyn over the radio?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_11: All members can donate to increase Guild Technology power, which will benefit all members.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_12: That's all, Commander. Now it's time for you to connect with your allies.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_13: All are ready to fight Pandora tanks!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_14: Now we just need to wait for them walking into their ending!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_15: Our victory will inspire all of those against them. The fire of resistance will burn even more fiercely.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_6_1: Now we can produce Tank Destroyers.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_7_1: With these troops, it'll be much easier to deal with enemy Tanks. If we have an Officer who can lead Tank Destroyers well, that would be even better.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_8_1: Are you adept at commanding Tank Destroyers?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_1_a: I'm back, Commander! I think we should find clues as soon as possible, and rescue Evelyn!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_3_a: Yes. Invaders are working on Project Pandora in secret, and as a doctor, Evelyn used to treat the wounded military officers responsible for the project because of her humanity. She will be the key to destroying the project.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_4_a: Slow down, Linda. The Invaders are getting stronger every day, so we must fully prepare ourselves before saving others.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_5_a: You're right. The Invaders' power is starting to worry me. Give the order, Commander. I'm sure you can make us stronger!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_7_a: Commander, we've just received a mysterious letter... with Evelyn's location on it!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_4_a: Linda: Commander, a plane from the Government is heading towards us. Could it be Evelyn?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_5_a: Linda: Oh, and here's a letter.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_title_a: With the intel Evelyn gathered, the secrets of Pandora are starting to unravel. This could be the key to turning the tide. But we need allies. Join or create a Guild, so we can have enough strength to fight against Pandora.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_5_a: All set. Now we just have to wait for the Pandora to come.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_7_a: Let's keep developing and getting stronger before the Pandora is here.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_10_a: Commander, we've received another letter, just like the last one.

Tutorial_Tutorial_MiniMap_chat_5: They've besieged the Government and concentrated their forces outside of each capital to form a strong defensive line. Our connection with the Government is completely cut off!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_49_Zom: The map shows that Maria was abducted and brought to a base where the invaders conduct horrible experiments. I know that place but I'm afraid our existing troops are not enough to handle it.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_49_Zom: The map shows that Riven was abducted and brought to a base where the invaders conduct horrible experiments. I know that place but I'm afraid our existing troops are not enough to handle it.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_mc_penelop: The invaders are secretly continuing the Pandora program and it seems they've kidnapped Evelyn to experiment on her. Saving Evelyn will be key to dismantling Pandora.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_mc_lawrenc: The invaders are secretly continuing the Pandora program and it seems they've kidnapped Evelyn to experiment on her. Saving Evelyn will be key to dismantling Pandora.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_mc_penelop: You're right, the invaders' zombie army is making my skin crawl. We await your orders, Commander, you can make us stronger!

Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_01: Commander, our Museum is now open for business.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_02: The museum is a place to collect and manage artifacts. Let's go in and take a look.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_03: Please click the button to unlock the Museum.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_04: Welcome to the Museum, Commander. Let me give you a brief introduction.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_05: The Museum is a place for collecting and managing Artifacts. All Artifacts discovered by Commanders during their world exploration will be sent to the Museum for centralized management.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_06: Artifacts can provide us with various boosts, helping us gain an advantage in combat.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_07: The museum has just opened and is still empty. Come on, let's go to the Artifact Market to find some artifacts.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_08: Good News! We have acquired our first Artifact.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_09: Tap the artifact to view its details.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_10: You can view the details of the artifacts here. Of course, you can also enhance the artifacts here.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_11: After collecting a certain amount of Artifact Fragments and Ancient Books during world exploration, Commanders can enhance their Artifacts.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_12: For more detailed rules, please visit the Museum Rules page.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_13: Here you can view the overview of boosts provided by the current artifacts.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_14: Go collect more artifacts to gain even stronger boosts.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_15: Welcome to the Exhibition Hall. Let me give a brief introduction.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_16: The commander can display collected artifacts in the exhibition hall for visitors to admire.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_17: The higher the rarity of the exhibited artifacts, the more popular they are with visitors, and the higher the revenue of the exhibition hall.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_18: Your daily income will be settled in the form of Gold at 00:00 UTC the next day. Please remember to collect it.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_19: Additionally, the artifacts on display will provide extra exhibition boosts. This is very important.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_20: Next, please display an artifact in a booth in the exhibition hall.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_21: Please select the artifacts to exhibit.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_22: The artifact has been successfully displayed in the exhibition hall!
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_23: It seems you have already gained a basic understanding of the Museum and Artifacts. Next, please explore the secrets of the Artifacts on your own.
Tutorial_Soldier_Ship5_01: Report Commander, our new warship has been completed, go check it out!
Tutorial_Soldier_Ship5_02: Montana-class battleship (BB-67 Montana), standard displacement of 63,221 long tons, full load displacement of 70,965 long tons, length of 921 feet, width of 121 feet.
Tutorial_Soldier_Ship5_03: Equipped with powerful weapon systems, the protection against torpedoes and artillery is also greatly enhanced.
Tutorial_Soldier_Ship5_04: May it accompany you to victory in every battle, invincible and unstoppable.
